turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Just This Once
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Mark MacLene (Peter Lawford) is a millionaire playboy, but he won't be one much longer if he keeps blowing through his inheritance. In an effort to control his spending, Mark's executor, Judge Samuel Coulter (Lewis Stone), hires lawyer Lucy Duncan (Janet Leigh) to watch over Mark. The two are even forced to live together, much to the dismay of Lucy's boyfriend, Tom (Richard Anderson). At first Mark tries to ditch Lucy and her frugal ways, but soon he finds himself falling for her. (Comedy) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Reformer and the Redhead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Kevin G. Maguire (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Kathleen (June Allyson), work at the local zoo as the superintendent and tour guide, respectively. As such, they believe that all animals should be treated with kindness, which conflicts with the views of a powerful and crooked political boss (Ray Collins). When the boss has Maguire fired due to this difference, Kathleen springs into action by contacting an attorney and mayoral hopeful (Dick Powell) for help in saving her father's job. (Comedy) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Adam's Rib
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A courtroom rivalry finds its way into the household when prosecuting lawyer Adam Bonner (Spencer Tracy) faces off against his wife, Amanda (Katharine Hepburn), who happens to be a defense attorney. Working on opposite sides of a lawsuit where a woman (Judy Holliday) has shot her cheating husband (Tom Ewell), Adam and Amanda are both determined to win the case, and their home becomes the setting for comical showdowns, with neither spouse willing to relent. (Romantic comedy) - 1949

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Glenn Miller Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Glenn Miller (James Stewart) is a poor trombone player with dreams of fame. Eventually, through years of hard work and determination, he is able to start his own band, and they become one of the most successful groups of the big-band era. With a beautiful wife (June Allyson) and one of the biggest songs in America, "Moonlight Serenade," Miller has it all. But at the onset of World War II, Miller enlists, giving up his fame and success to help entertain the troops stationed in Europe. (Biography) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Fabulous Dorseys
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Growing up in a coal-mining community in Philadelphia, Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey (playing themselves) are encouraged by their father, Thomas (Arthur Shields), to study music. The highly competitive siblings are soon playing with their father's band. As grown men, the Dorseys begin touring with their own ensemble, with childhood friend Jane Howard (Janet Blair) on vocals. Despite their rising success, the bickering brothers have a falling out, and Jane schemes to reconcile them. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Gene Krupa Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This musical biopic is based on the life of Gene Krupa (Sal Mineo), the famed jazz drummer. His Catholic parents want him to be a priest, but Krupa rebels and moves away to make it as a musician in New York City, along with his friend Eddie (James Darren). He eventually falls for a girl, Ethel (Susan Kohner). But the seductions of other women, drugs and fame -- plus a lack of a formal music education -- put a strain on his personal and professional life, and Krupa must re-examine his goals. (Biography) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cabin in the Sky
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When compulsive gambler Little Joe Jackson (Eddie "Rochester" Anderson) dies in a drunken fight, he awakens in purgatory, where he learns that he will be sent back to Earth for six months to prove that he deserves to be in heaven. He awakens, remembering nothing and struggles to do right by his devout wife, Petunia (Ethel Waters), while an angel known as the General (Kenneth Spencer) and the devil's son, Lucifer Jr. (Rex Ingram), fight for his soul. (Musical) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Reet, Petite and Gone
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: To claim his inheritance a jazzman (Louis Jordan) must find the right kind of woman. (Musical comedy) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hi-De-Ho
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Fast-talking manager Nettie (Ida James) helps legendary jazz bandleader Cab Calloway (Cab Calloway) land a steady gig at the exclusive Brass Hat Club. Upon hearing the good news, Calloway's untrusting girlfriend, Minnie (Jeni Le Gon), mistakenly assumes that he and Nettie are having an affair. As Calloway and his band prepare for their maiden performance at the Brass Hat, the vengeful Minnie asks Boss Mason (George Wiltshire) -- the thuggish owner of a competing club -- to put a hit on her man. (Musical) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mystery Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When bargirl Vivian (Jan Sterling) discovers that her married boyfriend has refused to leave his wife, she steals a car and drives to Cape Cod to confront him. Several months later her skeleton washes ashore, and local police officer Peter Moralas (Ricardo Montalban) must work with Harvard forensics expert Dr. McAdoo (Bruce Bennett) in order to piece together the twisted tale and discover who the murderer is before an innocent suspect pays the ultimate price. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bad Day at Black Rock
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When John J. Macreedy (Spencer Tracy), a one-armed war veteran, arrives in the small desert town of Black Rock, he's not greeted warmly. Searching for a man named Komoko, Macreedy is met with disdain by virtually every local, including the resident thug, Hector David (Lee Marvin), and the imposing Reno Smith (Robert Ryan). As Macreedy's investigation deepens, hostility turns to violence -- and to imminent danger for the mysterious and inquisitive stranger. (Crime drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Edge of Doom
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the death of his ailing mother, Martin Lynn (Farley Granger) feels desperately alone. His only concern is that his mother receive an elegant burial. Unfortunately, Martin is also in a dire financial situation and cannot afford an expensive church service. Enraged, Martin viciously directs his frustrations at a clergyman, killing him. The impulsive act leaves Martin in an even more despondent state, though a kindly priest (Dana Andrews) may be able to guide the young man toward redemption. (Crime drama) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Witness for the Prosecution
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Seven Days in May
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: U.S. President Jordan Lyman (Fredric March) hopes to bring an end to the Cold War by signing a nuclear disarmament treaty with the Soviets, much to the displeasure of the hawkish General James Scott (Burt Lancaster), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. When Scott's aide, Martin "Jiggs" Casey (Kirk Douglas) stumbles on shattering evidence that the General is plotting a coup to overthrow Lyman in seven days, "Jiggs" alerts the President, setting off a dangerous race to thwart the takeover. (Thriller) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Swimmer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Well-off ad man Ned Merrill (Burt Lancaster) is visiting a friend when he notices the abundance of backyard pools that populate their upscale suburb. Ned suddenly decides that he'd like to travel the eight miles back to his own home by simply swimming across every pool in town. Soon, Ned's journey becomes harrowing; at each house, he is somehow confronted with a reminder of his romantic, domestic and economic failures, until a final visit with an old flame (Janice Rule) leaves him devastated. (Drama) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Professionals
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band whether they should honor their agreement. (Western, Action, Drama) - 1966

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sentenced to life in solitary confinement after killing a prison guard, despondent inmate Robert Stroud (Burt Lancaster) combats loneliness and tedium by nursing an ailing bird back to health. Stroud develops an interest in caring for birds and becomes a talented ornithologist. actionmax.us.title: Mickey 17
actionmax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: The Rover
actionmax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
actionmax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Girls Trip
actionmax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
actionmax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
actionmax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

actionmax.us.title: Smoking Tigers
actionmax.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: Nerve
actionmax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Robin Hood
moremax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Alto Knights
moremax.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Broken City
moremax.us.description: Former cop Billy Taggart (Mark Wahlberg) sees a chance at redemption for past sins when New York City's Mayor Nicolas Hostetler (Russell Crowe) calls on him for a special job. Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Black Butterfly
moremax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

moremax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
moremax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
moremax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Camp Hell
moremax.us.description: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

moremax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
moremax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
moremax.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

moremax.us.title: Life of Pi
moremax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Head Office
moremax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Friendship

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eight

moremax.us.title: Get Him to the Greek

moremax.us.title: MacGruber

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers

sbssydney.au.description: S1 E8 Episode 8 Dr Mike is on the road visiting stud farms, a cat has a lucky escape with a deadly snake, and Dr Chris gets up close with one of Australia's most venomous reptiles.

sbssydney.au.title: Rescuing the Nile's Sunken Temple

sbssydney.au.description: S5 E3 Fitzroy Crossing, Bellenden Ker, Inverloch Ernie cruises the ancient waterways of Danggu Gorge, Aaron catches up with a talented woodcarver in QLD's sugarcane country and Narelda tries her hand at natural horsemanship in regional Victoria.

sbssydney.au.title: The Supervet
sbssydney.au.description: S8 E4 Lexi, Charlie And Locky Noel gives Maine Coon cat Lexie a bilateral total hip replacement, while one-year-old bouncy Border terrier Charlie is in pain and is struggling to walk, and dwarf rabbit Locky has broken his leg.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Midtlylland, Denmark Tareq pays a visit to the western part of Denmark, where he explores the region called Midtjylland.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E3 Deep Fried Mullet With Vegies, Fish Soup, Som Tum With Fried Mackerel And Blue Bone Sitting high on the red cliffs at Whalesong is a beautiful little surprise-a Bush Restaurant run by Lenny O'Meara and his wife Jacinta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E22 A German Influence Maggie Beer is passionate about the Barossa Valley and it's German Heritage. She's a proud spokesperson for the area and its many and varied food producers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E36 Episode 36 Laura is in the heart of the Barossa Valley, making her mum's Coconut Cake. She then teams up with produce expert Catherine Velisha for a pickling masterclass.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E6 Mexican-Style Hot Brown Rachael puts a spicy twist on the classic Hot Brown sandwich by adding jalapeno bacon, shredded pepper jack cheese, and bold Mexican flavours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E31 Episode 31 Laura proves her title as the Pasta Queen with her Timballo Pasta. Veggie Farmer Catherine Velisha brings a Roasted Broccoli with Butter Bean Puree dish that is chockfull of vegetables.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Tomatoes Jamie Oliver cooks tomato salad, fusilli with salsa rossa cruda, oven-baked sausage ragu, pale pink tomato and vodka consomme top and tails.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E60 Episode 60 Special guest Luke Hines joins Everyday Gourmet today to whip up his delicious Spicy Sweet Potato Rosti with Indian Avocado Smash.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E6 Eating For Good Sleep Dr Michael Mosley shows Adam and Brihony Dawson what to cook for a good night's sleep and gives some tips on how to get a solid 8 hours a night.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E12 An Unexpected Party Last minute guests equals no time to freak out and cancel, and Mary's minimal effort menu will impress in a flash.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E6 Dress Up Dinner The dishes might 'look' a little fancy, but they are super easy and give a little flair to your dinners! Lidia makes Belgian red endive salad, naked ricotta dumplings, and chats about stuffed tomatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E1 The Champion Of English Cheese Will visits influential cheese retailer Neal's Yard Dairy in London, where cheese champion Randolph Hodgson explains how English traditional farmhouse country cheese was saved from extinction.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Humble Beginnings Buddy visits two restaurants that thrive on recipes handed down through generations. First, he heads to Mamoun's Falafel, an iconic Middle Eastern joint in New York City's Greenwich Village.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E17 Ospedaletti Luana cycles along one of Italy's longest coastal cycling routes, cooks with renowned chef Gennaro Vivo, discovers an extraordinary collection of Art Deco and Asian art.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Trysil, Norway The mountains and months of snowfall in Trysil mean that this winter sports town has to be creative when it comes to what they can do locally.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Barramundi In Paperbark With Bush Spices Stuffing, Turkey Vermicelli & Mushroom & Freshwater Mussels Geikie Gorge is where you will find Ali and Mitch in this episode. Their cousin Mary Aitkin will verse the girls in cooking Barramundi wrapped in paper bark and cooked in white river sand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E23 Winter And Chocolate The weather's cooler, the ugg boots are on, and the fires are roaring. Before the Winter Blues hit, why not cheer up with some chocolate.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E37 Episode 37 Laura starts the show in the beautiful McLaren Vale, making her Minestrone Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E7 Bruschett-O-Rama Rachael shows how to make five delicious bruschettas featuring onion, puttanesca, mushroom, artichoke, and beet.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E6 Episode 6 Anchovies are the star of this episode, and love them or hate them, they're indispensable in Italian cooking. Luca explores their intense, savoury flavour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Roasted Garlic And Rosemary Prime Rib Rachael shows how to make an impressive holiday meal that will make your guests feel like VIPs with her recipe for roasted garlic and rosemary prime rib that she serves alongside her mother Elsa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E32 Episode 32 Laura cooks up a stir-fry dish that is the perfect recipe for the end of a long week.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Courgettes There's a bumper crop of courgettes in Jamie's garden and he shows us how to utilise them whilst they are in season. Not only do they come in all shapes, sizes and colours but the delicate flowers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E61 Episode 61 Seafood, Duck and Dessert...sounds like a weird combo but we promise you the recipes on today's show are delicious!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E7 Too Hot To Cook What do you make when it's too hot to cook? Adam's very cool guests, actor Bert LaBonte and chef Rodney Dunn, join him to make food that's fast and refreshing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Party Food Eva shares tasty, bite-sized delights perfect for festive entertaining, including Bang Bang Cauliflower, Panko Prawns, a Korean Sausage Roll Wreath, and a surprising Soy Chocolate Mousse.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 More Will Than Skill Jordan North has more will than skill when cooking, so joins Mary for some simple recipes to impress his pals, and as a thank you takes her to the pub for a pint and game of darts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Hertfordshire Joe Swash and The Batch Lady, Suzanne Mulholland help the Shah family streamline meals to save money, and reduce stress with brilliant, delicious batch cooking recipes and hacks.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E11 The Bbq Triangle Which style of BBQ reigns supreme - Kansas City, Houston, or North Carolina? Tony journeys to all three cities to taste for himself the secrets behind sauces, wood pits, and slow smokers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E12 My Friend Linh Tony returns to Hanoi, Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday of Tet. Together they enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Trysil, Norway The mountains and months of snowfall in Trysil mean that this winter sports town has to be creative when it comes to what they can do locally.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E4 Barramundi In Paperbark With Bush Spices Stuffing, Turkey Vermicelli & Mushroom & Freshwater Mussels Geikie Gorge is where you will find Ali and Mitch in this episode. Their cousin Mary Aitkin will verse the girls in cooking Barramundi wrapped in paper bark and cooked in white river sand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E23 Winter And Chocolate The weather's cooler, the ugg boots are on, and the fires are roaring. Before the Winter Blues hit, why not cheer up with some chocolate.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E37 Episode 37 Laura starts the show in the beautiful McLaren Vale, making her Minestrone Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E7 Bruschett-O-Rama Rachael shows how to make five delicious bruschettas featuring onion, puttanesca, mushroom, artichoke, and beet.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E32 Episode 32 Laura cooks up a stir-fry dish that is the perfect recipe for the end of a long week.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Courgettes There's a bumper crop of courgettes in Jamie's garden and he shows us how to utilise them whilst they are in season. Not only do they come in all shapes, sizes and colours but the delicate flowers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E61 Episode 61 Seafood, Duck and Dessert...sounds like a weird combo but we promise you the recipes on today's show are delicious!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E7 Too Hot To Cook What do you make when it's too hot to cook? Adam's very cool guests, actor Bert LaBonte and chef Rodney Dunn, join him to make food that's fast and refreshing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E13 Life Is A Fryway Mary is road trip ready with recipes that are snackable, packable, and won't make a mess of your car or clothing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E7 Breakfast At Lidia's Colazione! It's breakfast time, and Lidia makes some Italian touches to American classics - fried potates with sausage and eggs, bacon, egg, and cheese risotto, and finally ricotta pancakes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E2 Twins Of The Mediterranean: Corsica And Sardinia Despite being close neighbours, these two large islands in the Mediterranean have distinctly different cheese traditions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Meat Madness Get ready for the meat sweats, because in this episode, Buddy's hitting up two iconic spots that don't skimp on the meat.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E18 Genes The capital of Liguria reveals its splendour through history, architecture and gastronomy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Aland Part 2 After making an intial trip to this special archipelago in Season 1, Tareq goes back to Aland to explore more of this island territory.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E5 Ground Baked Kangaroo Tails With Damper, Kangaroo Curry, Steamed Barramundi Pockets & Bush Berries Miitch and Ali travel to Yakanarra Community in the desert country south-east of Fitzroy Crossing to cook up a storm with Beryl Henderson and Michael Moora.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E24 In The Hills When Simon returned to Adelaide, after studying to be a chef, he had a whole new appreciation for the Adelaide Hills. As a youngster he's tear around the hills on his motorbike.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E38 Episode 38 Laura teams up with vegetable guru Catherine Velisha to create wonderful Prawn Dumplings, with spring onions as the hero ingredient.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E7 Episode 7 The season concludes on a luxurious note with one of the most beloved ingredients: butter. With its creamy, nutty sweetness, butter elevates every dish.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Holiday Lasagne Rachael shows how to make delicious lasagna by layering sheets of pasta with cime di rapa, ricotta, and a ragu sauce that includes sweet sausage. It's then covered with cheese and baked to perfection.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E33 Episode 33 Laura brings her young nephew Noah on the show and together they make cookies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: When rugby league goes into extra time special things happen, the best Golden Point victories from the NRL.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Face to Face on Fox
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Coverage of the Face-To-Face on Fox.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Grand Final Classics : 1966 STG v BAL
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: Classic tries, heroic plays, first class performances. These are the games that created the legends.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: Origin Classics : 2005 Game 2
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: State against State. Mate against Mate. FOX LEAGUE celebrates one of the fiercest rivalries in Australian sport with the greatest State of Origin matches ever played.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Rabbitohs v Knights EF
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: What a way to begin the finals series. They've shared the honours in two classics this year & face the pressure of their season being over with a loss.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Warriors v Dolphins QF
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The atmosphere in Auckland will be off the charts! Both their 2026 clashes were two-point thrillers & a prelim final spot is the prize for this blockbuster.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Sharks v Cowboys EF
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The Sharks host this knockout clash at Allianz Stadium in Sydney & have lost their past two finals games against the Cowboys in golden point.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Panthers v Roosters QF
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: In Rnd 27, the Panthers won the minor premiership & the Roosters rested nine players. It's one-each in 2026, the winner of this moves to a prelim final.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Roosters v Sharks Semi Final
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: The Roosters won both games this year, but lost an elimination final to the Sharks in 2025. The winner advances to meet the Dolphins.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Warriors v Knights Semi Final
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: A bigger venue means even more support for the Wahs at Eden Park. The Knights advanced after upsetting the Rabbitohs. The Panthers await the winner.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Dolphins v Roosters PF
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: A place in the Grand Final up for grabs & box office match-ups galore in an Origin-like atmosphere at Suncorp Stadium.

NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.title: NRL : Panthers v Knights PF
NSW-SydneyFOXLEAGUE.au.description: A classic David & Goliath game, with the Panthers in their seventh straight Prelim, while the Knights try to extend their rise from 2025 wooden spooners.

BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E4 Time and the Rani: Part 4 As Mel convinces the Lakertyans fight back, the Tetraps turn on the Rani and the Doctor ensures the missile is deflected away from the asteroid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E5 Paradise Towers: Part 1 The legendary Paradise Towers is supposed to be the height of luxury but when the Doctor and Mel arrive, they find it is as far from a paradise as possible.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E6 Paradise Towers: Part 2 With the Doctor condemned to death by the caretakers and their bizarre rulebook, Mel faces cannibalistic OAPS. Is Pex going to be the true hero of Paradise Towers?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E7 Paradise Towers: Part 3 Mel and Pex play cat and mouse with the lethal cleaner robots while the Doctor and the surviving Kangs learn all about Kroagnon the Great Architect.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E8 Paradise Towers: Part 4 Kroagnon has been reborn, and is using the Chief Caretaker’s reanimated corpse to move around Paradise Towers. To stop him the Doctor must teach the residents teamwork.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E9 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 1 The Doctor and Mel win a trip to Disneyland in 1959 but after an accident in space, they actually end up in South Wales instead, along with an assassin and his intended victim.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E10 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 2 Gavrok and the Bannermen have arrived on Earth, searching for Delta and slaughter the holidaymakers without compunction to draw her out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E11 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 3 As Billy and Ray do what they can to help save Delta and the baby, the Doctor and Goronwy the beekeeper face Gavrok and his Bannermen one last time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E12 Dragonfire: Part 1 On Iceworld, the Doctor and Mel meet Ace, who has found herself there after a timestorm. While Ace nearly joins Kane’s mercenaries, the Doctor and Glitz explore the ice caverns.

BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E13 Dragonfire: Part 2 The Doctor and Glitz meet the infamous dragon, which is really a biomechanoid. Meanwhile Kane turns on his allies, as he cannot trust anyone in his search for the dragonfire.

BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E14 Dragonfire: Part 3 Shown the archive by the biomechanoid, the Doctor discovers that Kane is from the dead world of Proamon. Mel witnesess the destruction of the Nosferatu and Ace faces temptation.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E4 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 4 The streets of East London shake under a civil war being fought between the Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E6 The Happiness Patrol: Part 2 The Doctor escapes the Kandyman while Ace meets the Pipe People. Later, fleeing for her life, Ace is captured and selected to audition for the Happiness Patrol.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E8 Silver Nemesis: Part 1 A group of Neo-Nazis in South America are seeking the Nemesis Statue – as is a shuttle full of Cybermen and the mysterious Lady Peinforte from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E9 Silver Nemesis: Part 2 The Cybermen have the Nemesis Statue but Lady Peinforte and Richard fight back because they were prepared with gold-tipped arrows and De Flores still has a plan to set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E10 Silver Nemesis: Part 3 The Nemesis Statue is alive, thanks to Lady Peinforte's insanity, and with De Flores's Nazi’s wiped out by the Cybermen, Nemesis claims it has secrets to reveal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E11 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 1 Bellboy and Flowerchild escape the Psychic Circus but are pursued by the Chief Clown. The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to Segonax, some of whom are not what they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E12 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 2 The mysterious family watching the acts within the ring, dissatisfied with Nord, destroy him. Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he’s not the next to displease them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E13 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 3 Ace and Bellboy team up to stop the Chief Clown while the Doctor realises that he is next into the ring. The Captain has another trick up his sleeve and shows Mags's true colours.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E2 Battlefield: Part 2 The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur’s spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern, while Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart arrives in Carbury where he encounters Morgaine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E3 Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E4 Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E5 Ghost Light: Part 1 The Doctor and Ace explore Victorian house Gabriel Chase and realise it hides just as many dark secrets in its Drawing Room as it does in the dark cellar.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E6 Ghost Light: Part 2 The Doctor and Scotland Yard’s finest, Inspector Mackenzie, attempt to question Josiah Smith while both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E7 Ghost Light: Part 3 Only Redvers, still searching for the elusve Saxe-Coburg, seems to be able to withstand Light and communicate with Control and Ace realises her past actions need to be dealt with.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E8 The Curse of Fenric: Part 1 As Russian forces approach the English coastline, an ancient evil stirs beneath the surface of the water. For Ace and the Doctor, a deadly game of revenge has begun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E9 The Curse of Fenric: Part 2 The Viking runes in the crypt contain a secret to Ace’s past, while Millington and Judson’s Ultima machine offers to break the chains of the Wolves of Fenric.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E10 The Curse of Fenric: Part 3 The Haemovores attack St Jude’s church and the insane Millington willingly sacrifices his men. Doctor Judson dies, only to be reborn as the true evil, Fenric himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E11 The Curse of Fenric: Part 4 The Ancient Haemovore stands upon the Earth once again, determined to change the future by erasing the past and Ace finally feels love for her mother.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E12 Survival: Part 1 Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered by a Cheetah-Person on a horse called Kara, who transports her to a far-off planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E13 Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E21 Shada The 2017 animated reconstruction of the unaired serial. On the planet Shada, the Time Lords have built a prison for the Universe's most dangerous criminals.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E1 Series 5 Episode 1 Rob Brydon hosts with team captains David Mitchell and Lee Mack who lead celebrity guests Jack Whitehall, Rebecca Front, Nick Hewer and Miranda Hart.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E2 Episode 2 Adam and Jamie test the action movie cliché of Dumpster Diving. When the hero's cornered on a rooftop, can a leap into a skip below really save you, or is it just Hollywood hype?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 New Malden It's a secret mission to challenge the very best of them as Phil heads to New Malden in Surrey, and a semi-detached family home which has the busy A3 in the front garden.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E7 Floating Home And A Magical Vista A couple creates an ambitious floating home; two siblings build their own mobile homes away from home; George and Will conjure up a magical 30-mile vista in a wall just 20 cm thick.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E33 Episode 33 YolanDa Brown, Rev Kate Bottley, Joel Dommett and John Thomson continue to test their general knowledge skills.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E24 Bob Sedergreen, Beth Hart, Frank Woodley & Cal Wilson Josh, Ella and Adam are joined by Bob Sedergreen, Beth Hart, Frank Woodley and Cal Wilson.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S23 E3 Weaponry Join Sandi Toksvig for a look at some Weaponry with Nish Kumar, Lou Sanders, Roisin Conaty and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S17 E6 Craig Charles, Amy Gledhill, Shazia Mirza & Jeremy Vine Rob Brydon is back as host, with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Sorting the fact from the fiction this week are guests Craig Charles, Amy Gledhill, Shazia Mirza and Jeremy Vine.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Death In Paradise
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E5 The team investigate the murder of a former children's home resident. Meanwhile, Marlon sits his sergeant's exams, and Selwyn meets his daughter for the first time.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Elementary ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E15 How to Get a Head Holmes and Watson's investigation into the murder of a religion professor puts them on the hunt for a killer connected to the occult.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E22 One More For The Road Mark acts out violently but refuses to admit that he has a problem. Anspaugh delivers an ultimatum. Benton's premature baby struggles to survive. Charlie is brought in with an overdose. Doug and Carol share a kiss. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E5 Old Acquaintance Lee joins Facebook and is contacted by his ex-girlfriend Karen from twenty years ago. As hidden secrets from their past are revealed, a jealous and angry Lucy crashes Lee's dinner date accompanied by her old flame Ben.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Charts
ABCMESydney.au.description: E322 rage Vault: ARIA Awards 1996 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Morning Glory
ABCMESydney.au.description: Trouble ensues when a feisty producer attempts to revive a struggling news program with feuding co-hosts.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Phil Spencer: Secret Agent
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E15 New Malden It's a secret mission to challenge the very best of them as Phil heads to New Malden in Surrey, and a semi-detached family home which has the busy A3 in the front garden.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E3 Louisween It's Louis' favourite holiday, and he makes every attempt to scare Jessica into the Halloween spirit, but she is buried in her word processor, drafting her first horror novel. Meanwhile, Emery and Evan debate costume choices.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ABC News Update
ABCMESydney.au.description: E230 Thursday 19 November 2026 The headlines from ABC News, updating you on the day's top stories from across Australia and around the world.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E15 Idleness Tonight the QI panel are giving themselves up to an evening of idleness and indolence, with Ross Noble, Dara O'Briain, Jeremy Clarkson and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Adventure Time
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E16 Guardians Of Sunshine Finn and Jake go into BMO to defeat an evil Big Boss.

ABCMESydney.au.title: We Baby Bears
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E27 Teddi Bear In an endless junkyard the Bears meet Teddi, a sentient teddy bear.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E47 Strength of a Grown Man Needing a hero with shrinking powers, Robin forgets about Bumblebee and invites the Atom to join their fight against the Brain.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E9 Largo When a mysterious rain cloud plagues Townsville, Bubbles learns things aren't what they seem.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E25 Catalyst (heroes' Day Part 1) It's Heroes' Day in Paris and everyone must do a good deed for the occasion. But the day turns into a nightmare when Hawk Moth akumatizes Nathalie into Catalyst to put the plan he's been preparing for so long into action.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E14 The Riding Mistress Bill is shocked when Thunder is put up for sale and she desperately tries to keep him. Meanwhile, the Third Formers play a fun prank on Miss Vernon.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gangnam Project
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E9 Dress Rehearsal Tensions rise between Hannah, Sun Hee, and Mina as they struggle to rehearse for Showcase without a leader. Meanwhile, Leo is still processing not being able to be with DJ, and takes it out on the rest of his group mates.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 The Relationship Rory is bewildered and confused when he finds out a grade six girl likes him and Debra-Jo can't understand why she feels so cross about it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E34 Having A Wailord Of A Time A new Trainer is stopping by a Pokemon Centre to choose her first partner Pokemon, and Nurse Joy asks Ash and Max to take care of Treecko, Torchic, and Mudkip for her!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E9 Witwicky - Part 1 The Maltos party after retrieving the last Embershard, but Mo forgot all about her history report due tomorrow! With Hashtag in tow, her simple research trip becomes a wild adventure revealing what makes Witwicky so special.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E4 Daddycop To celebrate her hundredth kiss with Adrien, Marinette has planned a romantic evening - forgetting that she'd already planned a movie night with her girlfriends at the same time!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Snow It is snowing today. Peppa and George must wear their hats and scarves and gloves. They have lots of fun playing in the snow, making footprints and throwing snowballs. Then they build a snowman, complete with hat and scarf and gloves.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E13 Dance With The Tree Of Wisdom Let's dance with The Tree of Wisdom, shake our arms, Wiggle like no one's watching, and learn some new moves along the way!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E7 Spoilsport Shaun persuades Bitzer to take part in his game of Cricket but Bitzer is more worried about the condition of the pitch than the game.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Adventures of Paddington
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Paddington And The Talent Show Paddington discovers Mr Brown is a fantastic dancer so enters him into the Town Hall Talent Contest. However, Mr Brown gets stage fright. Paddington to the rescue!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Puppy Dog Fun At Doggy Adoption Day, Swarm uses collars to cause chaos with the pups.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E38 Sploshy Splash Owlette learns to rely on instincts after she's lured into an evil trap.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E61 Mini Golf Goof Ghost-Spider teams up with Ant-Man and The Wasp to stop Green Goblin from ruining the mini-golf course.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Family Picture Day Ariel preps Ayanna for picture day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Little Sister When Flower begs her parents for a little sister, she borrows Tutu for the day to see what it's like; but chaos quickly erupts. In the end, Flower realizes she already has the perfect playmate: Flour.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S11 E33 Super Picnic Super Potato is hosting a picnic but as he begins to tell his stories, the children have multiple requests for him to fulfil including flying everyone home!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E38 Copycat Bluey's having fun copying everything Dad says and does, but the game takes a serious turn when Bluey finds a hurt budgie and they have to make an emergency trip to the vet.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E15 Roar Off Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes inadvertently start a massive roar off with all the other Vegesaurs.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E22 The Everything Day When Pounce's dad Hoppa visits Kangaroo Beach for the day, Pounce tries to cram everything into one day and forgets to heed basic safety principles.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E33 Talon Show At the Familiar Talent Show, Annette and Clarion learn to put competition aside for friendship.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mojo Swoptops
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Flock and Roll Jackson's sheep will ruin Preston's flower festival unless Mojo and Bo can round them up!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Andy And The Bald Eagles When Mr Hammond's bald eagle feather is damaged, Andy jets off in his safari-mobile to Alaska in search of another. Along the way, he meets a brown bear fishing for salmon.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E2 Wonderful World 2: South Africa Hunter and Emma add the final touches to some savannah animals and learn where they can be found on a world globe. Hunter is taught the gumboot dance from South Africa by special guest Pepsie.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S16 E12 Herding Hazard The Pioneers work on Annie's farm, but Sarah accidentally lets the sheep go loose. They knock over Annie's stove which starts a fire.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 Secret Shell Zip has been using snails to create drawings and pretending he did it himself. But his friends show him that art is about expressing your true self.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Woohoos!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E23 Wiggly Worm Woohoo Worms wriggle out of the ground close to where Scotty is chanting and marching, the Woohoos are intrigued. They try lots of ways to encourage the worms to come up and play.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Guess How Much I Love You
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 March like an ant Little Nutbrown Hare is disappointed when a trail of ants disappears with the delicious spring berries he's found.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E55 MIffy the Shop Helper Barbara's shop is getting reviewed by the local newspaper, and Miffy volunteers to help Barbara get it ready for inspection.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Sound Collector
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E43 Lost In The Fog The Sound Collector gets lost in the fog, and has to use sound to get him home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Fish in Water DJ Swimfins is driving to her concert in the park, but her RV gets stuck in the mud. Mittens, Fire Chief Grapefruit and others in Kibble Corners try to help the DJ move her van. Will they succeed?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BeddyByes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 Matching Game MeMo and BaBa have fun finding and matching shapes all over Planet BeddyByes. MeMo helps BaBa to match the shapes in a picture book when they visit their friends, the Yummies.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E2 Episode 2 The toddlers are visited by a baby goose. Fantus helps a little zebra find its parent.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E10 Rug Island On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything - bananas, campfires, even a snake! But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Buses Beep! Beep! Jump aboard with Fizzy and Suds as they spend a day riding on a beautiful big bus. After that, let's see the bus have a bubble bath!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Fruit Party Hannah and the junior gardeners celebrate her goats Gilly and Gertie's birthday with a special fruity surprise a fruit cake made entirely out of fruit!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E2 John's Fruit Salad John seeks help from Fruity and Fresca, the strength specialists, as he faces a challenge of losing strength due to missing breakfast. Explore the letter 'R' then sing-along to the 'Banananana' song!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends

nbcuniverso.us.title: Caso cerrado - Que se saque los ojos; Estafa embrujada
nbcuniverso.us.description: Camilo exige que su esposa vuelva a casa y lo atienda, cuando quedó ciego, ella lo abandonó. Vanessa pide que invaliden el traspaso de su inmueble porque actuó bajo los efectos de una brujería. (Reality TV, Legal)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - No puedo vivir sin ti
nbcuniverso.us.description: Cuando Ana Laura y Carlos firman el divorcio, el juez le otorga a ella la custodia de su hija Yolanda. Poco después, el acosador que la persiguió por años reaparece, pero ya no se trata del mismo hombre. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Cuando el amor es verdadero
nbcuniverso.us.description: Eladio trae a su sobrina Mercedes a su casa, lo que molesta a su esposa y a su hija Beatriz. Ellas desprecian la relación de Mercedes con el panadero, pero cuando el amor es verdadero supera todas las barreras. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Lorena, el que la hace, la paga
nbcuniverso.us.description: Un duro pasado convierte a Lorena en una mujer agresiva e irracional. Ella y su familia solo entienden la violencia como forma de vida y al no poder controlar la rabia, pierden el control. (Drama, Soaps)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - María, tras las rejas
nbcuniverso.us.description: La relación de María con Cristóbal fue más allá de gritos y manotazos. Una noche de copas dejó a Cristóbal en coma y a María tras las rejas. En espera de un juicio, la vida de María da un giro inesperado: está embarazada. (Drama, Soaps)

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E07 Evelyn Zigerelli-Henderson When a retired Dauphin County sheriff is found burned to death, investigators zero in on his wife's bizarre behavior; they must quickly determine whether the death was the result of a mental health crisis or a malicious plan to kill.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E08 Stella Lacy A missing family man is found murdered in his car near his home in New York; when evidence of a secret affair is exposed, detectives unravel a chilling conspiracy orchestrated by individuals close to him and a mastermind driven by greed.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E09 Julie Harper A respected family man is found shot to death in his upscale California home; as detectives race to find his killer, a startling confession exposes a web of lies, allegations of abuse, and a marriage pushed to its breaking point.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E10 Trista Hrabak A farmer is gunned down inside his Barron County, Wisconsin home in what appears to be a planned hit; as investigators search for answers, they turn to an unstable ex whose plot to kill shocks the rural community.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E11 Olivia Moody A beloved mother is fatally shot after a feud between two other women escalates into a group fight. Pine Bluff authorities interview witnesses to uncover the shooter's true motive as public opinion on the case grows increasingly divided.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E12 Jennifer Sweeney Just months after a shooting nearly takes her life, a New Jersey woman is reported missing; fearing her original attacker has returned to finish the job, investigators race to expose an elaborate murder plot and an obsessive killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E13 Natalie Cochran When a businessman collapses in his home under mysterious circumstances, investigators unearth a sinister plot to cover up a multimillion-dollar Ponzi scheme-and the woman who will stop at nothing to keep it hidden.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E14 Jacqueline Johnson-Cabrera The family of a respected corrections officer is shattered when they find him in his bed with a fatal gunshot wound; Florida authorities uncover a disgraced former officer whose jealousy and obsession lead to murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E05 Kristen Dean Jennings : After a Texas man goes missing, the investigation leads detectives to the estranged mother of his children. In an exclusive prison interview, Kristen Dean reveals the desperate lengths she went to for her daughter and the sinister plot behind it.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E01 A Deadly Homecoming A beloved college co-ed is murdered while jogging over Thanksgiving weekend in Acme, Washington; decades later, an intrepid co-worker plays an unexpected role in bringing her killer to justice.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E15 Antonetta Stevens When a young woman dies from injuries received in an apparent assault, detectives in Georgia open a homicide investigation that reveals infidelity, heartbreak, and the shocking video of a revenge plot gone horribly wrong.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E16 Nicole Nachtman A quiet Florida suburb is shaken by a couple's double homicide, launching detectives into a tense investigation; when evidence points to someone close to the victims, authorities unmask a killer with a tenuous hold on reality.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S36 E17 Tammy Moorer A South Carolina family is shattered by the sudden disappearance of their daughter just before she planned to launch her dream career; investigators track her last known movements that will expose a vengeance fueled by a jealous obsession.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E06 Stand Your Ground A teacher hosting a family birthday party is shot dead by an angry neighbor who captures the confrontation on camera; the shooter claims the video proves self-defense, but prosecutors say it shows he staged the showdown to get away with murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E04 Triangle of Guilt A young woman vanishes after a night out in Dallas, leading investigators to the home of an aspiring rapper in a twisted love triangle; following an international manhunt, prosecutors must prove who killed her with no weapon or cause of death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E32 Evil Was Watching Two young girls in Washington are snatched in broad daylight while riding their bikes; the case goes unsolved for decades, until a new detective with a local connection to the story tries to solve the mystery.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E33 11 Minutes The father of an Alabama teenager calls the police after he returns home to find his son had thrown a party, leaving the place trashed; 11 minutes after the deputy leaves the house, another 911 call is placed reporting a shooting at the residence.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E34 She Didn't Come Home Investigators didn't know if Kathy Heckel was a missing person or murder victim; decades later the case is reopened by a new detective.

oxygenwest.us.title: A Wedding and a Murder
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E03 Murder Close to Home The happiness of a second marriage is destroyed after a firefighter is felled by gun violence in front of his own home; his family, police and fellow firefighters search for justice and find out that the killer is someone he trusted with his life.

oxygenwest.us.title: A Wedding and a Murder
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E04 Deadly Triangle A motocross champion and a model tie the knot in Las Vegas, never knowing their wedding vows will trigger a mysterious murder plot and a decades-long investigation.

oxygenwest.us.title: A Wedding and a Murder
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E06 Praying for Murder After a man is found murdered, detectives search for a motive in the seemingly senseless slaying; after considering whether it was a case of mistaken identity or a robbery, investigators ask if secret desires caused a killer to strike in God's name.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 A Hopeless Romantic A young mother, with dreams of settling down, finally finds love online; her hopes for a romantic Valentine's Day take a terrifying turn when she's lured into a deadly trap, masterminded by a self-styled cult leader.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 The Hometown Hero When a promising young boxer is found murdered after arranging a date on Facebook, detectives follow his digital trail and uncover a sinister deception that suggests he may not have been the only target.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E05 The Deadly Offer When a New Hampshire handyman disappears after receiving a call from a stranger, investigators follow a trail of clues that leads to a connection and a carefully concealed motive.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E01 Thanksgiving Terror A woman is shot to death while driving her sons home from a Thanksgiving celebration; the hunt for her killer leads to an unlikely suspect, making investigators realize her murder is not as random as it seems.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E01 The Last Thanksgiving A Thanksgiving feast turns into a family's last when a cold-blooded killer brutally stabs and dismembers a couple the day after their holiday celebration.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E07 Cold Turkey A prominent couple are found brutally murdered in their Montgomery, Ala., home on Thanksgiving night, leading detectives on a cat-and-mouse chase spanning thousands of miles across multiple states.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E01 A Deadly Homecoming A beloved college co-ed is murdered while jogging over Thanksgiving weekend in Acme, Washington; decades later, an intrepid co-worker plays an unexpected role in bringing her killer to justice.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E02 Deadly Deception The murder of Jamie Faith appears to be a random street shooting until investigators uncover fake identities, thousands of messages and murderous manipulation; prosecutors must prove how a long-distance relationship led to murder in Dallas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E05 High-Heel Homicide A Houston professor is found bludgeoned to death in his high-rise condo. His ex-girlfriend claims she fought for her life with the only weapon within reach: her high-heel shoe. Prosecutors must prove where self-defense ends and murder begins.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Tourniquet Killer When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E06 Stand Your Ground A teacher hosting a family birthday party is shot dead by an angry neighbor who captures the confrontation on camera; the shooter claims the video proves self-defense, but prosecutors say it shows he staged the showdown to get away with murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E39 Hot on the Trail Serial arsonist on the loose leaves no evidence.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E40 High 'N' Dry A man becomes the prime suspect in his wife's death after forensic science raises questions about her apparent suicide.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E41 To the Viktor Investigators on both sides of the Atlantic seek links between three homicides that look like professional executions.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E42 Wired for Disaster Who put a bomb in the home of a 29-year-old woman and killed her?

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E43 Wood-Be Killer A killer tried to destroy everything which could link them to the crime; but in doing so, they inadvertently created new forensic evidence, evidence which came to light using a technique never before used in a criminal investigation.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E01 Sharper Image When murder strikes a young girl, police quickly make an arrest, but cutting-edge technology from NASA proves they have the wrong suspect behind bars.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E02 Insulated Evidence A man is found strangled and burned in his San Antonio apartment and the killer thinks he has destroyed all the evidence.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E03 Cold Hearted When two men appear to die of heart disease six years apart, police notice they have one thing in common, they were each married to the same woman.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S12 E04 Wheel of Misfortune Casino security cameras offer the final images of a woman, just before she vanishes without a trace; can these grainy images lead police to her killer?

syfy.us.title: Godzilla
syfy.us.description: During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wrsp.us.title: Storm of Suspicion
wrsp.us.description: Stories can be told from a rain puddle or a pile of snow, but only a forensic meteorologist has the ability to look at these and help solve murders. "Storm of Suspicion" highlights crime and weather and how these two can be intertwined. Elements -- like dew drops or even the temperature -- can be the key to unlocking more clues to solve crimes. The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints. Dr. Elizabeth Austin, a forensic meteorologist who has worked on countless cases in which weather and crime go hand in hand plays a part in the series. (Crime, Reality, Weather) - 2018-10-07

Fitting perfectly alongside such projects is "Live PD," which shines a light on the hot-button issue of policing in America by presenting a transparent look at law enforcement on duty. fxm.us.title: Ready or Not
fxm.us.description: Grace couldn't be happier after she marries the man of her dreams at his family's luxurious estate. There's just one catch -- she must now hide from midnight until dawn while her new in-laws hunt her down with guns, crossbows and other weapons. As Grace desperately tries to survive the night, she soon finds a way to turn the tables on her not-so-lovable relatives. (Horror, Thriller, Dark comedy) - 2019
