fxm.us.description: Oscar-winning fantasy in which the residents of a Florida rest home get a new lease of life when they stumble across an alien "fountain of youth" in a disused holiday home. Unbeknown to them, aliens have been using the swimming pool in the house to store their cocooned brethren, giving the waters a powerful, rejuvenating quality. (Fantasy) - 1985

fxm.us.title: Nightmare Alley
fxm.us.description: Roustabout Stanton Carlisle joins a traveling carny and unsuccessfully schemes to figure out the mind-reading act of Mademoiselle Zeena and her alcoholic husband, Pete. But when Pete dies, Zeena is forced to take on Stanton as a partner, and he quickly proves more gifted than his predecessor. Ambitious to a fault, Carlisle abandons Zeena and the carny to reinvent himself as The Great Stanton, wowing high-class audiences in a Chicago hotel. (Crime drama) - 1947

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: The Detective
fxm.us.description: When a gay man is viciously slain, Detective Joe Leland (Frank Sinatra) is put on the case. Joe eventually tracks down the victim's roommate, who confesses to the crime and is sentenced to death; however, the outcome of the case doesn't sit well with the detective. Norma (Jacqueline Bisset), a distraught widow, visits Joe. She believes her husband's death was no accident, but the cops don't seem to care. Joe begins to investigate, and stumbles on a cover-up related to his previous case. (Crime drama, LGBTQ) - 1968

fxm.us.title: The French Connection
fxm.us.description: New York Detective Popeye Doyle (Gene Hackman) and his partner (Roy Scheider) chase a French heroin smuggler. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: The French Dispatch

documentary+.us.title: Hung up on a Dream: The Zombies Documentary
documentary+.us.description: British icons The Zombies reflect on 60 years of their musical path, from teenage friends to legends in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

documentary+.us.title: The Arctic Oasis
documentary+.us.description: A look at Canada's Arctic, now threatened as climate change alters the ice.

documentary+.us.title: Arctic Alchemy
documentary+.us.description: Renowned adventurer and climate scientist, Roman Dial embarks on a research expedition in the Alaska Arctic.

documentary+.us.title: Finding Gulo
documentary+.us.description: Finding Gulo follows a ski guide & field biologist who document an elusive population of wolverines.

documentary+.us.title: Understory
documentary+.us.description: Follow three women who set sail on a 350-mile expedition through Alaska's massive Tongass National Forest. Their goal is to explore how clear-cut logging in this coastal rainforest could affect local communities and our planet's climate.

documentary+.us.title: Range Rider
documentary+.us.description: In the Kettle River Range of Northeastern Wash., wolves are being killed to protect livestock that graze on public lands; a lone range rider, Daniel Curry, works year-round using non-lethal mitigation methods to help save wolves.

documentary+.us.title: School Of Fish
documentary+.us.description: School of Fish offers an intimate portrait inside one family's seasonal salmon rituals and their connection to the Bristol Bay Fly-Fishing and Guide Academy, where local youth are empowered through fly-fishing to serve as guides and conservationists.

documentary+.us.title: The Last Blockbuster
documentary+.us.description: The manager of the last Blockbuster video store struggles to keep the store open.

documentary+.us.title: Sacred Cod
documentary+.us.description: The story of how the oldest fishery in the United States has been driven to the edge of commercial extinction; includes interviews with fishermen, scientists, advocates, and federal officials.

documentary+.us.title: Mahale Chimp Guardians
documentary+.us.description: People and chimpanzees live side by side in one of the world's most important biodiversity hotspot.

documentary+.us.title: Jaguar Spirit
documentary+.us.description: Jaguar Spirit uncovers how Bolivia became the global centre of the illegal jaguar trade.

documentary+.us.title: Dancing Warrior
documentary+.us.description: On Pine Ridge Reservation, Lakota teens find hope racing horses in Indian Relay.

documentary+.us.title: Gilbert
documentary+.us.description: Comedian Gilbert Gottfried recounts his career and talks about his new life as a family man.

documentary+.us.title: THC, Inc
documentary+.us.description: With cannabis now mainstream, young people face rising potency, predatory marketing, and outdated policies.

documentary+.us.title: 40 Watts From Nowhere
documentary+.us.description: Frustrated by what she was hearing on commercial radio, Sue Carpenter built a 40-watt FM station in 1995 and ran it out of her apartment in Los Angeles, exploiting a legal case that allowed hundreds of low-power radio operators to proliferate.

documentary+.us.title: Charm Circle
documentary+.us.description: The announcement of a polyamorous wedding threatens to sever what's left of a family bond.

documentary+.us.title: Now! More! Yes!
documentary+.us.description: TW Hansen is a legally blind used car salesman, a landlord, and a film car coordinator living in Milwaukee. One of TW's tenants began following him with a camera after he drunkenly purchased an ambulance using his boss's money.

documentary+.us.title: The House From...
documentary+.us.description: Filmmaker Tommy Avallone examines famous homes from movies and television series and interviews the people who live there in real life.

documentary+.us.title: Age of Audio
documentary+.us.description: The resurgence of audio storytelling. From a vivid passion to an extraordinary billion-dollar industry.

documentary+.us.title: Seeding Change: The Power of Conscious Commerce
documentary+.us.description: Consumers are empowered to purchase from "triple bottom line" businesses that consider the social, environmental and financial impacts of their companies and address some of today's most challenging issues.

documentary+.us.title: Dolphin Lover
documentary+.us.description: Malcolm Brenner, human, and his romantic relationship with Dolly, bottlenose dolphin.

documentary+.us.title: Here's to Life: The Story of The Refreshments
documentary+.us.description: The story of The Refreshments, from one-hit wonders to being a respected band in a new era.

documentary+.us.title: Pick It Up! Ska in the '90's
documentary+.us.description: The rise and fall of Third Wave Ska music in the US.

documentary+.us.title: Getting Lost
documentary+.us.description: A retrospective documentary celebrating the 20th anniversary of the cultural phenomenon "Lost."

documentary+.us.title: The Last Blockbuster
documentary+.us.description: The manager of the last Blockbuster video store struggles to keep the store open.

documentary+.us.title: Built Different
documentary+.us.description: Twelve-year-old Paige Calendine was born without legs and competes at state and national competitions against normal-bodied kids in archery and gymnastics; her inordinate determination and courage make her built different.

documentary+.us.title: State of Firsts
documentary+.us.description: Sarah McBride's groundbreaking campaign becomes the first transgender Congressional victory amid anti-trans political tension.

documentary+.us.title: Dirty Coin: The Bitcoin Mining Documentary
documentary+.us.description: Is Bitcoin mining an environmental threat or an energy solution? This documentary examines the debate surrounding crypto mining around the world.

documentary+.us.title: Talking Drum
documentary+.us.description: Explore the healing power of drumming through community leaders using the universal language of rhythm.

documentary+.us.title: After Skid Row
documentary+.us.description: For over a decade, Barbie Carter was among the thousands on individuals living on Skid Row, Los Angeles. After being approved for housing, she forges a bond with an aid worker, and together they work to keep her off the streets.

documentary+.us.title: Nostradamus: The Truth
documentary+.us.description: An examination of the astrologer's predictions reveals myths and events that surrounded the life of the legendary figure who lived 500 years ago.

documentary+.us.title: Behind the Lines
documentary+.us.description: An army psychiatrist (Jonathan Pryce) treats a British poet (James Wilby), a young officer (Jonny Lee Miller) and others at a Scottish institution during World War I.

documentary+.us.title: The International Space Orchestra
documentary+.us.description: Nelly Ben Hayoun assembles the world's first orchestra made up of space scientists.

365blk.us.title: Bait
365blk.us.description: Landing in jail for a petty theft crime, Alvin finds himself sharing a cell with John Jaster, the incarcerated half of the pair of high-tech thieves responsible for the missing gold. His partner, Bristol, is still at large. Alvin wants only to get out of prison and start fresh with his girlfriend, Lisa, and when the Feds, led by U.S. Treasury investigator Clenteen, set him loose on a sketchy deal, he thinks his luck has changed. Alvin has his freedom and the Feds have found their bait. (Action, Comedy) - 2000

365blk.us.title: Law Abiding Citizen
365blk.us.description: Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2009

365blk.us.title: Queen of the Damned
365blk.us.description: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat. (Horror) - 2002

365blk.us.title: Freedom Song
365blk.us.description: Owen (Vicellous Reon Shannon) is a young man living in Mississippi at the dawn of the civil rights movement. Surrounded by racism, Owen looks for inspiration in dealing with oppression, while his father, Will (Danny Glover), prefers to keep his head down after his bad luck with protests in the past. Will expects his son to follow suit, but their relationship is put to the test when Owen starts joining in peaceful protests organized by the Student Non-Violent Coordinating Committee. (Drama) - 2000

365blk.us.title: 16 Blocks

Jack sees a way to redeem his wasted life by protecting the affable Eddie from the would-be assassins. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2006

4uv.us.title: 5 Guys a Week

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: A History of Violence
5starmax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
5starmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Contagion
5starmax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Scanners
5starmax.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
5starmax.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Science fiction) - 1973

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
5starmax.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Science fiction) - 1974

5starmax.us.title: Walkabout
5starmax.us.description: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Scream
5starmax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Repo Men
5starmax.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Flashpoint
5starmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
5starmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
5starmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Blood Simple
5starmax.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
5starmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

5starmax.us.description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping. - 2000

5starmax.us.description: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand. - 2011

5starmax.us.description: A photographer (Louise Smith) and others work for a yuppie madam (Ellen McElduff) in a Manhattan brothel, then go home. - 1986

5starmax.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business. - 1986

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E41 The Insignificant Anniversary Episode Nick forgets an anniversary while the children star in internet videos wearing superhero costumes as they give out advice to users.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E39 The Inappropriate Website Episode Nick pulls up an adult website at work on accident; Suzanne stays at home for a couch delivery; Lindsey studies for a Shakespeare test.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E19 The Tit for Tat Episode When a new woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened; Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E56 The Identity Theft Episode Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E11 The Valentine's Day Episode Nick lends a hand to Kevin for his Valentine's Day at school, but things take a turn as Kevin ends up being sent home.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E16 The Take Your Kids to Work Day Episode When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's; a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother that she never knew about.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E22 The Test Taker Episode Kevin assists Frankie in preparing for an exam, but Frankie offers a bribe to persuade Kevin to take the test on his behalf.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E30 The Nick's Kid Episode Suzanne learns the mother of Kevin's new friend Nathan is Nick's old fling; she suspects that Nathan could be Nick's son.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E55 The Sex Symbol Episode After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image; Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E49 The Bucket List Episode Nick creates a bucket list of very dangerous activities; Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy operation at school.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E05 The Boy Has Style Episode Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay; Nick sets out to prove that he is not in order to save Lindsey from facing disappointment.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E38 The Cyrano Episode Nick helps a coworker by writing love letters to a woman on a dating site, only to find that the woman getting the letters is Gigi.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E03 The Day Off Episode Nick decides the kids need to bond with his mother and asks that they spend time together; Suzanne has a day off, but she does not know what to do, now that she has a lot of time on her hands.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E13 The Expensive Purse Episode After balking at the high price of a purse Suzanne loves, Nick thinks again and tries to buy it as a gift, but Suzanne has already secretly bought the last purse for herself.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E03 The Bad Dream Episode After Kevin watches the horror film "The Sixth Sense," he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E01 The Mr. Himdependent Episode When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank abandoning his own responsibilities.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E14 The Master of Ceremonies Episode While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E51 The Hand on a House Episode Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E29 The Nick Gets an Assistant Episode Nick is forced to get an assistant, who is a must-hire from his boss; when the assistant gets too close to his family and friends, Nick is forced to take action.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E05 The Rat in the House Episode When a rat gets lost in the home, Kevin scurries to care for it. Meanwhile, an ex-flame creates surging tension between Lindsey and Gigi.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E08 The Man and the Bragging Snafu Episode When Nick's colleague at the station encourages him to send Lindsey and Kevin to a private school, Nick and Suzanne look into it, only to be misled about the process.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E09 The No Nah Nah Episode Nick says he is too tired for marital relations one night, leading Suzanne to speculate and have major concerns that something is not right in their relationship.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E18 The Pole Dance Episode Suzanne catches Nick watching a rap video with a pole dancer in it and decides to show him that she is the best pole dancer on the block.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E06 The Regift Episode Suzanne is upset when Marilyn gives her an ugly bracelet as a present, but things get even uglier when Nick sees it and realizes he bought it for Marilyn and that she's re-gifted.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E24 The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop while Nick plays the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E44 The Long Con Episode Kevin buys a cheap mask at a yard sale, but it may be a valuable art piece; Lindsey receives advice about her upcoming date with her crush.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E45 The Bigg Box Klub Episode The gang shop until they drop when they get a membership at a discount bulk store; Lindsey enters a speed-texting contest.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E54 The Blackout Episode A night out with the guys leaves Nick missing his wedding ring, along with his memories of the evening.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E50 The Kleptomaniac Episode Nick is asked to host a charity walkathon; Marilyn's bracelet is missing, and the children train to participate in the walkathon.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E11 My First Job Episode Lindsey learns about stealing at the workplace when she lands her first job and gives out free food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E20 The Quarantine Episode When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E33 The Pocket Dial Episode After Nick gets pocket-dialed by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocketing dialling her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E40 The Thanksgiving Episode The entire Kingston-Persons clan is at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, but Suzanne's forgotten one thing, the turkey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E29 The Fight Party Episode Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E05 The Cooking Episode Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E32 The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode Nick and the kids throw a birthday party for Suzanne because she has never had one.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E20 The Salsa Episode Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E09 The Green Episode The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they realize sometimes you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

choppertown.us.description: S11 E5 Bouquets and Blowtorches The team returns from a successful mission in Vegas, but there's trouble brewing within the crew's ranks.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E7 Sugardaddy Shakedown The team wonders what's up with Sonia as she wrestles with Lou's big secret.

choppertown.us.description: S11 E8 The New Boss Lou has retired, making Sonia the new boss, but will she be able to keep the company going?

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E9 Hayseed Inferno Sonia pushes the company to repossess more than just cars, and the backlash threatens to end her time.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E10 Bullseye! Sonia is still struggling to keep the team in line.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E13 Mile High Mayhem On this special season finale of Operation Repo, the team gears up for a mile high repo of a lifetime!

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E14 Reclaim the Plane In this Operation Repo, the team must recover an airplane and return one-hundred thousand dollars.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E15 First Rule of Repo Froy and Sonia encounter a city employee who tries to give them the boot.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E20 Taken for a Ride A professional stunt driver slips through Froy and Sonia's grasp, sending them on a violent high speed chase.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S11 E22 It Ain't No Joke! The cast takes viewers back through the most outrageous, comical, and memorable repos of the series.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S1 E1 We Are Operation Repo The Operation Repo team faces a bike-riding gangster and a persistent young debtor.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S1 E2 Don't You Dare Lift-off Froy, Matt, and Lou turn tail and bail when bats and guns are swung towards them.

choppertown.us.description: S1 E3 Collectibles Lou, Lyndah, Matt grab speedboat, truck, trailer, repo rare motorcycle, Froy, Sonia, Lou take forklift.

choppertown.us.description: S1 E5 Pizza, Hook-ups, and a Suspicious Suitcase Matt and Froy disrupt a couple's tryst, repo a car from a pizzeria, then face challenges at a car graveyard.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S1 E6 Exterminate or Retaliate Lou orchestrates a truck ambush. Then, they repo a tractor and confront punk kids for four wheelers.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E1 Unwanted Seizures Lou orders a Toyota repo post-divorce, has Froy and Matt tail another, and aids a seizing debtor.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E2 Pepper Spray and Guns First, Froy and Sonia douse a couple with a dose of pepper spray when the debtor gets too pushy with Sonia.

choppertown.us.description: S2 E3 Who Wants Ice Cream? First, Sonia, Matt, Froy, and Lou roll up and roll on a gang of brothers to gain possession of an Infinity.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E4 The Cop, the Pizza Delivery Man, and the Repo Men Lou sends Sonia & Froy to repo. Matt & Froy face citizen & cop. Sonia, Lyndah, & Matt confront repo agent.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E5 Hairy Situations Sonia&Lyndah repo near wig shop. Pepper spray chaos with Lou & Froy. Froy, Sonia, & Lou face thugs for repo.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E6 Legal Repossession Matt, Froy, & Lou repo attorney's car. Froy, Lyndah, & Sonia interrupt scene. Lou & Sonia handle ATVs.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E7 Business Issues Sonia and Lou deal with a terrible boss and his instigating employees.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E8 Wrench in the Works A wrench is thrown in the works, and at the car, when Froy and Matt try to repo from a plumber.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E9 Hidden Cars and Higher Powers Matt and Froy get some help from a friendly gardener that lead them to discover a car hidden in the backyard.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S2 E10 Rolling Away Lou, Sonia, and Froy have to push away a debtor while trying to push a classic car up a hill.

choppertown.us.description: S3 E1 Matt's Back Froy & Mike repo at paintball range. Matt intervenes. Sonia & Froy repo sedan. Matt & Lou take risky job.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S3 E2 Burgers, Bottles, and Hustlers Lou & Sonia repo from gangsta gals. Matt & Froy dispute with burger-slinger. Sonia & Froy face hustler & crew.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S3 E3 Strapped On the Court Matt and Froy have to choose between the job and their lives.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S3 E4 Role-players and Blade Swayers Lou, Matt, & Froy face owner with blade. Matt & Froy reclaim Prius from role-players.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S3 E5 Caught with Their Pants Down Sonia and Froy's repo turns bizarre with strangers. Lou, Lyndah face indecent ranchers; chaos at pool hall.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S3 E6 Honor Rolling Away Sonia & Lyndah confront student. Matt & Sonia face armed thugs. Lou & Sonia repo Escalade from couple.

choppertown.us.description: S3 E8 Intoxicated Marina Idiots Lou & Sonia pursue Porsche & Audi. Matt & Froy recover truck. Matt & Lou seize BMW from rich couple.

choppertown.us.description: S3 E9 Playing the Role Lou devises a plan to have Froy and Sonia pose as house buyers.

choppertown.us.title: Operation Repo
choppertown.us.description: S3 E10 Broken Bones and Broken Phones Froy, Lou & Matt face bodybuilders for Jeep. Lou & Lyndah startle broker. Froy learns text lesson from Sonia.

cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Dos estudiantes de Derecho viajan de regreso de sus vacaciones para presentar un examen y el encuentro con su escultural vecina los involucrará en una intriga política. (Comedy drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 2008

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Gatillero
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Al intentar matar a un gatillero, por error asesinan a su mujer. En la búsqueda del culpable, el gatillero se encuentra con un hombre sin principios que se dedica a robarle a la gente del pueblo, y se enfrentan en un duelo a muerte. (Action) - 1998

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Los Verduleros 2
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Peripecias y aventuras de un grupo de oficiales de policía que trata de resolver casos cuando puede y si no, se retira. (Comedy) - 1987

cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Una conspiración del gobierno para socavar al presidente Trump y a sus partidarios, exponiendo corrupción, engaño y traición dentro del sistema que pretende proteger a la democracia. (Documentary) - 2024

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: La Mujer de los Dos
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Un hombre se enamora de una mujer misteriosa, pero ella le pertenece a otro hombre. (Romance) - 1996

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: La última sombra

Una ola de violencia y asesinatos se produce por este motivo, pero entre balas y sangre será difícil descubrir el rastro de La Última Sombra. (Action, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: En Preparación
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Unos narcotraficantes matan a los padres de Daniel y este queda bajo la custodia de sus tíos, que no lo aceptan. Solo su primo, Damián, traba amistad con él. Sin embargo, al crecer, sus vidas toman caminos muy diferentes y Damián se hace policía mientras que Daniel trabaja como sicario para la mafia. (Action) - 2010

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Los verduleros
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Dos policías descubren que un respetado comandante es en realidad un asesino, tras lograr capturarlo son ascendidos. (Comedy) - 1986

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Las nuevas calenturas de JC
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Juan Camaney se hace pasar por un poderoso brujo en el pueblo, con el único propósito de tener el respeto y temor de los habitantes. (Comedy) - 2001

cinemadinamitalatino.us.title: Tres Mexicanos Ardientes
cinemadinamitalatino.us.description: Tres hombres casados cortejan a una modelo, pero ella se burla de ellos. (Comedy) - 1987

cinesony.us.description: Un alpinista y sus captores se persiguen por peligrosas montañas, en una singular lucha por obtener un dinero robado. (Movies, Action) - 1993

cinesony.us.title: Moon
cinesony.us.description: El astronauta Sam Bell vive aislado durante tres años en una excavación minera lunar. Poco antes de que llegue el reemplazo, mientras sufre dolores de cabeza y alucinaciones, Sam descubre la presencia de una versión más joven de sí mismo. (Movies, Sci-Fi) - 2009

cinesony.us.title: Quarantine
cinesony.us.description: Una reportera y su camarógrafo quedan atrapados en un edificio y graban la epidemia de una enfermedad desconocida que transforma a los humanos en caníbales viciosos. (Movies, Horror) - 2008

cinesony.us.title: Take Shelter
cinesony.us.description: Un hombre de Ohio intenta desesperadamente proteger a su familia después de que unas visiones aterradoras lo convencen de que un desastre apocalíptico se cierne sobre ellos. (Movies, Drama) - 2011

cinesony.us.title: Retreat
cinesony.us.description: En una isla aislada, el intento de una pareja para recuperarse de una tragedia personal es destrozado cuando un desconocido les informa de una enfermedad aérea que está arrasando con Europa. (Movies, Thriller) - 2011

cinesony.us.title: The Caller
cinesony.us.description: Una mujer divorciada y con problemas se convierte en el objeto de una terrible venganza cuando intenta eliminar una serie de misteriosas llamadas telefónicas. (Movies, Mystery) - 2011

cinesony.us.description: Un espacio único que reúne los detrás de cámaras de las películas de acción más relevantes de Hollywood. (Performing Arts)

cinesony.us.description: Dos hermanas enfrentan sus problemas románticos en la Inglaterra del siglo XIX donde reinan el dinero y la sociedad. (Movies, Romance) - 1995

cinesony.us.title: It Could Happen to You
cinesony.us.description: Un policía enfrenta a su codiciosa esposa cuando cumple su palabra de compartir el premio de la lotería con una mesera. (Movies, Romance) - 1994

cinevault.us.title: Solo
cinevault.us.description: Android military weapon Solo (Mario Van Peebles) is designed to put down Latin American rebels. But when Solo arrives, the machine feels compassion for the rebels fighting for freedom. Despite Solo's design, he begins fighting for the people he's supposed to kill. When his creators, including Gen. Haynes (Barry Corbin), attempt to bring him back, he flees. But the military doesn't give up. They send an upgraded android into the field to take Solo -- and the villagers -- down. (Action, Movie) - 1996-08-23

cinevault.us.title: 7 Seconds
cinevault.us.description: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-06-28

cinevault.us.title: Suspect
cinevault.us.description: Carl Anderson (Liam Neeson), a deaf, mute and homeless war veteran, is arrested for the murder of a prominent judge's secretary. But Kathleen Riley (Cher), Anderson's lawyer, believes her client is innocent. She sets out to track down the real killer, and, as the trial proceeds, makes an unlikely ally in Eddie Sanger (Dennis Quaid), a jury member. When they aren't in court, the two investigate the case and manage to uncover a massive conspiracy. (Movie, Thriller) - 1987-10-23

cinevault.us.title: Obsessed
cinevault.us.description: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2009-04-24

cinevault.us.title: Random Hearts
cinevault.us.description: After a plane crash in which both their spouses are killed, Sergeant Dutch Van Den Broeck and Congresswoman Kay Chandler's lives are connected. Their spouses were headed to the same address, with identical keys, under Mr. and Mrs. plane tickets. The investigation leads to startling discoveries and an unexpected romance. (Drama, Movie) - 1999-10-08

cinevault.us.title: The Shadow Riders
cinevault.us.description: Mac Traven (Tom Selleck) is a Civil War veteran who fought for the North, while his brother, Dal (Sam Elliott), was allied with the South. In spite of this considerable point of contention, the siblings must work together when they find that other family members have been abducted, along with Dal's girlfriend, Kate (Katharine Ross). Joined by their trouble-making uncle "Black Jack" (Ben Johnson), Mac and Dal relentlessly pursue the criminals to rescue their relatives. (Movie, Western) - 1982-09-28

cinevault.us.title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story

fetv.us.title: Life Today
fetv.us.description: James Robison was a former preacher who changed directions in his life and began hosting this television show alongside his wife, Betty, in order to reach out to help more people. This daily religious and self-help program welcomes guests who tell how they have successfully overcome difficulties in their lives by following God's word -- with the hope of encouraging others to do the same and look to God for help and guidance in times of need. The Robisons provide viewers with Bible-based advice to help them deal with everyday problems. (Religious, Show, Talk) - 1996-09-23

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S17 E10 Vicki judges the Best Supercar award at the most exclusive motor show in the world, Salon Privé.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E01 Ben Collins is put through his paces as the team challenges him to tame an 800-bhp dragster.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E02 Jason teaches Radio One's Comedy Dave to drive a race-inspired Aston Martin convertible; Jonny gets a ride in Europe's fastest street-legal car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E03 Tiff offers a unique behind-the-scenes glimpse of the final British Touring Car Championship race of the year as Jason attempts to clinch the championship; Vicki reveals everything you need to know about Renault's convertible, the Wind.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E04 Jason heads to Silverstone to set a new lap record for a road-legal production car; Tiff pits two leading BMWs head-to-head.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Tiff and Jason team up with F1 aces Johnny Herbert and Karun Chandhok for the ultimate dogfight. Vicki tests Vauxhall's new compact MPV, the Meriva; Ben samples the motorsport Autograss, and Jonny sees what motoring delights he can find for £5000.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E06 Jonny and Ben perform a two-wheel stunt; Vicki puts the four-door Mini Countryman through its paces.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E07 Tiff and Jason race two of the fastest off-roaders on the market, the Audi Q7 V12 and the Porsche Cayenne Turbo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E08 Jason tests the Sport Turbo from track-car specialists Westfield.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E09 Jonny and new boy Ben Collins, the driver who used to be the Stig performs a two-wheel driving stunt; Vicki Butler-Henderson puts the radical new four-door Mini Countryman through its paces; Tiff Needell races two fast but green coupes head to head.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S18 E10 Vicki presents the Fifth Gear Annual Awards for best small, family and fast car, and the show's overall Car of the Year; Tiff and Jason team up with Ben Collins to test three closely matched sports cars.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E01 Tiff and Jason put pedal to metal on the Yas Marina in Abu Dhabi; Vicki zips around the winding streets of Monaco in a £40,000 hot hatch; Jonny meets an ingenious car engineer; in the Team Test, the team reviews the BMW X3 four-wheel drive.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E02 Jason takes the new Aston Martin for a spin in Spain; Jonny heads to Norway; Tiff tries his hand at ice-driving in Lapland; Vicki test-drives the powerful new BMW M3 GTS.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E03 Tiff Needell tests a new estate car from Ferrari; Vicki Butler-Henderson puts two luxurious diesel saloons against each other on the track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E04 Jason and Tiff face-off in supercars; Jonny hits the Nürburgring track in Germany.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E05 Tiff Needell and Jason Plato visit the Ferrari World theme park in Abu Dhabi; Vicki pits Lotus against Porsche on a twisty track in the Netherlands.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E06 Vicki hits southern Spain with BMW's new convertible.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E07 Jason Plato and Jonny Smith celebrate the Jaguar E-Type's 50th birthday by retracing a journey from the car's past; Tiff Needell thrashes the brand new BMW1 Series M Coupe in Scotland.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E08 The team is joined by legendary Hollywood stunt coordinator Vic Armstrong.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E09 Tiff road-tests a Lamborghini in Nice; Jonny gets horizontal in VW's improved Phaeton; Jason gets his rocks off with a Porsche at Rockingham; the team presents a guide to frugal motoring.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S19 E10 In a tenth-anniversary special, the presenters look back at some of their most memorable moments; Jonny attempts the Isle of Man TT circuit on a three-wheeled scooter; Tiff and Vicki test the BMW M3 GTS and the Porsche 911 GT3 RS.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E01 The team conduct a shocking 120 mph crash test; they pit the two most powerful Jaguars ever head to head; they blast through Croatia in a 150,000 pound Bentley.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E02 Tiff meets British rally legend Mark Higgins; the team test out a Mercedes convertible; Vicki races a Ford Mustang around Le Mans.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E03 Tiff Needell is at the wheel of Lamborghini's awe-inspiring new Aventador hypercar; Vicki burns through Italy's snowy mountain roads in Mini's brand-new Coupe; the team tests the latest Porsche.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson heads to Italy to drive a new convertible version of the brilliant Ferrari 458; Tiff Needell conducts a shootout between two ultra-powerful coupes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E05 Tiff Needell wrestles with the last ever Porsche 911 of its generation; Vicki Butler-Henderson tests a one-off $150,000 prototype version of Honda's CRZ Hybrid.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E06 The best driving track in the world; Vicki goes to Portugal.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S20 E10 Vicki Butler-Henderson learns evasive driving techniques from the police that chauffeur the royal family.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E01 Porsche 911 Carrera S Test Track Test-driving the Porsche 911 Carrera S; the crew hopes a new refueling method will allow it to break a world record for distance traveled in an hour.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E02 Tiff and Jason hold a knock-out tournament to see if the 570hp Mercedes SLS AMG can beat its rivals from Aston Martin, Bentley and Jaguar. Jonny meets Swedish rally legend Stig Blomqvist for some ice driving lessons in the new Audi A1 Quattro.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E03 Tiff conducts a crash test to show why everyone should make sure their next car has electronic stability control. Vicki is at a motor show in Monte Carlo, where she reveals the latest Pagani hypercar and test drives the controversial Fisker Karma.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E04 Tiff enters the opening round of the exclusive Lamborghini Super Trofeo race series - with advice from the man with every petrolhead's dream job - Lamborghini chief test driver Giorgio Sanna.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E05 Jason is in Iceland being taught how to race a brutal Formula Off-Road buggy up a cliff of volcanic rock by a former champion. Tiff is joined by former Le Mans winner Guy Smith to test a new version of Bentley's best-selling car - the Continental GT.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E06 Jason is joined by ex-Ferrari F1 driver Mika Salon to pit the brand new £100,000 Mercedes C63 AMG Black Series against its key rival from BMW. Tiff celebrates the iconic Ferrari F40's 25th birthday with a track drive of one of the best in the world.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S21 E07 Jonny Smith goes behind the scenes at the grueling Isle of Man TT motorbike race, and spends the day with TT hero and 19 times winner John McGuinness. Tiff Needell races around the infamous TT circuit in the brand new Subaru BRZ sports car.

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Stolen
filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. (Drama) - 1998

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Final Stand
filmriseaction.us.description: The story of the Podolsk cadets in October 1941 near Moscow during WWII, where the cadets of the Podolsk artillery-infantry schools receive orders to take up defenses on the Ilyinsky line. (Action, Drama, War) - 2020

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E04 Nobody Likes Me Martin takes baby James to playgroup, where he is forced to sing along with the other moms; Al signs up for a dating website; Bert finds Jennifer in the bathroom with a needle.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmriseclassictv.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
filmriseclassictv.us.description: This series follows the Clampett family from the Ozarks to posh Beverly Hills after they strike oil and become millionaires. Banker Mr. Drysdale tries to keep them from foolishly spending their newfound wealth, and he also tries to "civilize" them -- usually succeeding in making a fool of himself in the process. (Sitcom) - 1962-09-26

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A scientist (Scott Bairstow) finds a monster that devours its prey in the deserts of South Africa. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

indieplex.us.description: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted. (Horror) - 2004

indieplex.us.title: The Raven

When another murder occurs, also seemingly inspired by Poe's writings, Fields realizes a serial killer is on the loose and enlists Poe's help in catching the felon. The stakes become personal for the struggling author when someone close to him may become the killer's next victim. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2012

indieplex.us.title: Jack Goes Boating

Clyde and his wife decide to set up Jack with another friend, Connie (Amy Ryan). Jack and Connie hit it off, and a tentative romance blossoms, inspiring Jack to take cooking lessons, learn to swim, and apply for his dream job. However, as that relationship grows stronger, Clyde and his wife find their marriage crumbling. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

indieplex.us.title: Death Defying Acts

(Drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2007

justicecentral.us.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
justicecentral.us.description: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives. (Reality, Law) - 2016-09-12

network.us.description: A young girl claims she was raped in the stairwell of her apartment building; Benson and Stabler race to find a witness. (Drama)

network.us.description: When a disabled woman is beaten and raped, Benson and Stabler think someone close to the victim is responsible. (Drama)

network.us.description: When an investigative journalist is found murdered in her bed, Cragen recognizes tactics from a similar case 30 years earlier. (Drama)

network.us.description: Benson and Stabler must determine a murder victim's actual identity when the presumed victim turns up alive. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Beef
network.us.description: Benson and Stabler discover that a murder victim had been involved in the fight to expose questionable practices in the meat-packing industry. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Babes
network.us.description: While investigating the death of a teenager, detectives Elliot Stabler and John Munch discover a group of girls in a pregnancy pact. (Drama)

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Snatched

network.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Sugar

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Closer

retroplex.us.title: After Dark, My Sweet
retroplex.us.description: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts. (Crime drama) - 1990

retroplex.us.title: The Blood of Heroes
retroplex.us.description: Another woman joins a future gladiator's band of "juggers" against fighters of the ruling elite. (Action, Science fiction) - 1989

retroplex.us.title: Lulu on the Bridge
retroplex.us.description: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino). (Romance) - 1998

retroplex.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
retroplex.us.description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States. (Horror) - 1968

retroplex.us.title: American Heart
retroplex.us.description: This unflinching drama tells the story of recently released ex-convict Jack Kelson (Jeff Bridges) as he struggles to begin a new life outside of prison and build a relationship with his estranged teenage son Nick (Edward Furlong). With the deck stacked against them, Jack falls back on old habits as they struggle amid the vagrants and criminals of an impoverished section of Seattle. Just when it appears that they might succeed, Jack's past comes back to haunt him. (Drama) - 1992

retroplex.us.title: Any Last Words?
retroplex.us.description: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life. (Western) - 2012

retroplex.us.title: Thunder Town
retroplex.us.description: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Lawless Frontier
retroplex.us.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Westward Trail
retroplex.us.description: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Texas Terror
retroplex.us.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Hawk of Powder River
retroplex.us.description: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Badmen
retroplex.us.description: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Navajo Kid
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large. (Western) - 1946

There's also a passionate grower in London who uses every available space in his garden to grow a vast range of vegetables.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Rachel de Thame and Arit Anderson explore the role gardeners can play in having a positive impact on wildlife in their gardens, allotments and communal green spaces. 700407.title: Gardeners' World
