classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, op. 21
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 1. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in C-Dur Op. 21, und diese zeigt die Loyalität Beethovens zu den Modellen von Joseph Haydn und Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-04-02

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo. (Music) - 2000-04-23

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2021-09-24

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, live aufgeführt von Carlos Miguel Prieto mit der Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, zusammen mit der Mezzosopranistin Ruxandra Donose und dem Tenor Ramón Vargas, präsentiert Mahlers Lied-Symphonie. (Special) - 2026-04-04

classica.us.title: In the Organ's Stomach
classica.us.description: Olivier Latry, der aktuelle Titularorganist der großen Orgel von Notre-Dame, führt die Zuschauer mit seinem Instrument auf eine Reise durch Landschaften, die Geschichte und unglaubliche Abenteuer, deren Zeuge das Instrument war. (Special, Music, Classical, Performing arts)

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Sinfonie Nr. 2, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem Konzertprogramm, das Pjotr Iljitsch Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll, op. 17, "Kleiner Russe", enthält. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C-Dur, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, um den 250. Geburtstag des Komponisten zu feiern, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwarz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-11-28

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
classica.us.description: Nachdem er alle 32 Beethoven Klaviersonaten aufgenommen hat, entschied sich der gefeierte italienische Pianist Riccardo Schwartz dazu, Soloklavierwerke von Robert Schumann aufzunehmen. Carnaval, Op. 9 wurde in den Jahren 1834-1835 geschrieben. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-11-07

classica.us.title: Cartoons in Concert
classica.us.description: Beliebte Figuren aus der Welt der Cartoons und Animationsfilme treffen im Konzertsaal auf eine mitreißende musikalische Fusion. Gemeinsam mit Chören und Orchestern des DR entsteht ein einzigartiges Konzerterlebnis. Seien Sie gespannt! (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-12-24

classica.us.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt in diesem Konzert Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll. Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin bei diesem Konzert im Château de Chantilly dem Kammermusikrepertoire. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-03

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen jedes Jahr die Live-Übertragung des Neujahrskonzerts. Als die Drei Tenöre anlässlich der Fußball-WM 1990 ihr legendäres Konzert in Rom gaben, sahen weltweit eine Milliarde Menschen an den Fernsehern zu. Die Dokumentation untersucht, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, klassische Musik einem breiten Publikum näherzubringen. Was dachten Herbert von Karajan und Leonard Bernstein darüber, die als einige der ersten die Möglichkeiten dieses Mediums intensiv nutzten? (Documentary) - 2012

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonische Etüden, op. 13
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwarz Schumanns Symphonische Etüden op. 13. Das zwischen 1834 und 1837 komponierte Werk bestand zunächst aus einem Thema und einer Reihe von sechzehn Variationen. Es wurde von Baron von Fricken komponiert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-16

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-15

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Quintett für Klavier und Bläser, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Das Quintett für Klavier und Bläser in Es-Dur, Op. 16, von Ludwig van Beethoven wird im Auditorium Santa Cecilia in Perugia aufgeführt. Das Werk wurde 1796 vollendet und 1801 in zwei Fassungen mit Klavier und Bläsern oder Streichern veröffentlicht. (Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-04-12

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 6 in F-Dur, op. 68
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 6. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 68, welche in fünf verschiedene Sätze eingeteilt ist, wie "Blitz und Donner". (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-04-16

classica.us.title: Kammermusik von Janáček, Taffanel und Prokofjew
classica.us.description: Unter anderem spielt das Quinteto Zéphyros Leoš Janáčeks Mládí (Jugend) für Bläsersextett. Diese Aufführung wurde am 11. Mai 2024 im Auditorio Sony der Hochschule für Musik Reina Sofía in Madrid, Spanien, für die Übertragung aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-05

classica.us.title: Beethoven - - 5. Klavierkonzert, Op. 73
classica.us.description: Die Berliner Philharmoniker Daniel Barenboim und Claudio Abbado brillierten beim Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen. Die beiden Freunde präsentierten Ludwig van Beethovens 5. Klavierkonzert sowie Johannes Brahms 2. Sinfonie. (Music) - 2020-03-04

classica.us.title: Tripelkonzert, Op. 56 & Symphonie Fantastique
classica.us.description: Gianandrea Noseda dirigiert die KestonMAX-Stipendiaten der Music Academy und des London Symphony Orchestra in Ludwig van Beethovens Tripelkonzert in C-Dur sowie Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, in der sich ein Künstler mit Opium vergiftet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-09-27

classica.us.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
classica.us.description: Die Pianistin Martha Argerich spielt mit vielen Stars der klassischen Musik Ravels "Ma mère l'Oye". Das Konzert wird zugunsten des Erasmus-Fonds für medizinische Intensivpflegeforschung organisiert und dem Cellisten Aleksandr Khramouchin gewidmet. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-11-08

classica.us.title: Ice Dance: Dornröschen
classica.us.description: Die Imperial Ice Stars, ein Ensemble aus 26 Eiskunstläufern, bieten neue Blickwinkel auf die Geschichte Dornröschens. Aufgenommen 2004 in der Melbourne Theatre Company in Australien mit musikalischer Untermalung von Kompositionen von Tschaikowsky. (Special, Performing arts, Music, Classical) - 2020-10-13

draftkingsnetwork.us.title: All the Smoke Dugout : Adam Jones
draftkingsnetwork.us.description: Matt Barnes dives into the world of baseball with the biggest names in the MLB. This is: All The Smoke Dugout.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Who's Watching Us
maverickblackcinema.us.description: When Ruth is hired to babysit for the Harris family, she and the kids find out that someone else is watching them closely. Ruth and Jasmine must fight to protect themselves and her little brother Micah. (Thriller) - 2024

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Scarred
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Nate meets and hooks up with the beautiful Mia after a night out. Everything is beautiful, until Nate's wife Kamryn discovers his infidelity. The love triangle begins to spiral as everyone is on edge, and that some actions have deadly consequences.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Her Best Revenge
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A group of five fraternity brothers reunite after a decade apart, only to be haunted by a deadly secret from their past. (Crime drama) - 2026

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Bloodlines
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Sydney Carter is a restless college student that has always felt out of place. When she discovers she's adopted, her world beings to unravel, and she embarks on a journey to discover her origins, but they come at a cost, and could destroy everything she's ever known. (Crime drama) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Camera Girl
maverickblackcinema.us.description: After witnessing Atlanta's underground rap scene firsthand, a quiet but driven young woman buys her first camera and sets out to become a music videographer. But as she fights for recognition, she's pulled into a harsh world where talent is exploited and credit is stolen. Forced to choose between giving up or betting on herself, she risks everything to turn her passion into a career. (Drama) - 2026

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Why Not You
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Mario, a young dancer living in his small village, has to face the loss of his beloved friend Lenz, a victim of an attack in a gay club. (Drama) - 2020

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Played in My Face
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A woman's life begins to unravel when she receives an email exposing her fiancé with another woman. Her quiet suspicion spirals into obsession as she discovers that her fiancé's betrayal runs deeper than she ever imagined. (Drama) - 2026

maverickblackcinema.us.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart. With her friends rallying around her, they encourage Symone to embrace her single status and embark on a journey of self-discovery and love. (Comedy, Drama, Romance) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Why Women Trip
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Zori Johnson falls in love hard and fast, yet always seems to be hurt by those closest to her. When she meets the man of her dreams, their love connection spurs her to open her heart once again. (Drama) - 2022

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Bottle Girl
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Diamond's dream of going to college is threatened by financial hardship. A desperate job at a glamorous Atlanta lounge exposes her to a world of temptation and danger. (Drama) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: The Jealous Son
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits. (Drama) - 2025

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Enter The Ninja
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Ninja III: The Domination
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Hercules (2014)
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Flesh + Blood
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: RoboCop
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: RoboCop 2
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: RoboCop 3
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Futureworld
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims….

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Cherry 2000
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Tank Girl
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Lady In White
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Dead Of Winter
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Tentacles
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Amityville Horror (1979)
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Amityville 3-D
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: The home of unspeakable evil is back! Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Candy Clark and Meg Ryan star in this third outing to Amityville in which a skeptical journalist sets out to debunk the Amityville house's reputation for unspeakable evil.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Motel Hell
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this horror cult-classic, Vincent and his sister own the "Motel Hello," where they sell their delicious smoked meats made fresh on their farm. But something strange is going on over there. Folks are checking in...but no one is checking out!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Vicious Lips
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Night Of The Comet
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Count Yorga, Vampire
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Spikes Gang
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Three Old West farm boys help a wounded bank robber (Lee Marvin), and he teaches them the trade.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A scout (Lee Marvin) and his Indian sidekick (Oliver Reed) find their ex-partner (Robert Culp) spending their loot in 1908 Colorado.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Three Amigos!
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Three silent-film cowboys (Chevy Chase, Steve Martin, Martin Short) come to Mexico to perform but instead are expected to save a town.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) tries to be the Wild West legend his promoter (Burt Lancaster) creates for show business.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Comes a Horseman
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A rancher (James Caan) back from World War II helps a woman (Jane Fonda) fight a cattle baron (Jason Robards) who wants their Colorado land.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Invitation to a Gunfighter
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A town boss hires a gunslinger (Yul Brynner) to kill an outcast (George Segal), then hires the outcast to kill the gunslinger.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Return of the Seven
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: The man in black (Yul Brynner) forms a new Magnificent Seven, to save Mexican farmers from slave labor.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A mercenary (George Kennedy) recruits a knife man (James Whitmore), a gunman (Monte Markham) and four outlaws to free a Mexican patriot from prison.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A marshal (Lee Van Cleef), an Eastern reporter and five ex-convicts rescue widows from Mexican bandits.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Cast a Long Shadow
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A young man without surname inherits a big indebted ranch and has to prove his worthiness managing a cattle drive.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Super 8
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A series of unexplained events follows a horrifying train derailment, leading some young filmmakers (Elle Fanning, Joel Courtney) to suspect that the catastrophe was not an accident.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Congo
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Hard Rain
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A thief (Morgan Freeman), a sheriff (Randy Quaid) and the nephew (Christian Slater) of an armored-truck driver seek money bags in a flooding Indiana town.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Peacemaker
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A scientist (Nicole Kidman) and an Army Special Forces colonel (George Clooney) travel the globe in pursuit of stolen nuclear weapons.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Universal Soldier
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Dead soldiers from the '60s surface in the '90s as high-tech warriors reanimated by the U.S. government.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Time Machine
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A scientist (Guy Pearce) travels into the future and meets a race of people who fear hideous monsters living under the ground.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Escape From Alcatraz
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Hunted
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: After its boat capsizes, a group of migrants is rescued by rich Europeans who offer shelter on the island where they are vacationing. The miracle becomes a nightmare when the saviors reveal their true plan and turn into ruthless man hunters.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Eagle Eye
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Two strangers (Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan) become pawns of a mysterious woman who threatens their friends and family and uses technology to control their actions.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Collateral
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A contract killer hijacks a cab and forces the driver to transport him to his assigned jobs in Los Angeles.

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Now That Is a Bitchin' Ride
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Pantera is almost done, but nothing is simple with this car; Dave and Kev get a chance to upgrade their semi rig. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220104

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Holley Carb Tuning Tips
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Holley 4150 has been the gold standard for performance since it was released to the aftermarket in the '60s; resident carb whisperer Steve Brulé walks through all the tips and tricks to get a 4150 running best on any engine. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220715

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Slant-Six Manifold Shootout!!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Dulcich is at it again with his slant-six tomfoolery; with goals of his 225ci monster powering a daily driver '68 Dart, Steve is putting four aftermarket intake manifolds to the test to see which will give him the most grunt. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220722

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Rectangle vs. Cathedral Ports for LS Power!!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: A look at the difference in power potential between dime-a-dozen cathedral ports and the "racier" rectangular ports found on the LS3. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220722

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - The Battle of the Gen III Hemis!!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Engine Masters are battling two iterations of the 5.7 III Hemi and are learning a ton in the process; with an eye toward engine-swap simplicity, they have stuffed both with the biggest cams they can handle in the most affordable way possible. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220805

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - SBF Intake Shootout!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Windsor family gets its turn at an intake shootout; this Windsor is begging for the best single-plane manifold to breathe through and offerings from Edelbrock, Trick Flow, Ford Racing, AFR and SpeedMaster are sure to make small Ford sing. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220930

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Solid Lifter Cam Comparo; Roller vs. Flat Tappet
motortrendfasttv.us.description: It's the age-old battle of power vs. price; investigating whether choosing a solid flat tappet sacrifices power and whether the extra power of the hydraulic is worth it; talking duration, lobe intensity, spring pressures, dollars and horsepower. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220812

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Manifolds or Headers for Your Turbo LS
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Examining whether cast manifolds are enough to keep up with turbo motors, and at what point it should be running proper headers. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220812

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Does Fuel Temperature Matter?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Inspired by their previous study of coolant-temperature testing, the guys go one step beyond icing down the manifold, deliberately heating and cooling fuel to see the difference it makes. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220826

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Measuring the Max Wedge for a Street 440
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The Mopar Max Wedge head was once considered all but unobtanium, but the aftermarket has come to the rescue; testing a 270cc Trick Flow unit to see if the Max Wedge style, with its bigger intake runners and direct flow path, is a worthwhile upgrade. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220826

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Do Header Wraps Work?
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Manufacturers claim header wraps not only reduce radiant heat, but create additional power through their scavenging effects and superior heat management; a set of painted, ceramic-coated and wrapped headers are tested against one another. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220902

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Which Ram? All the Rams?!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys line up a bunch of Holley's Ram intakes on their 550 rectangle-port-headed 6.2-liter LS to help decide. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220902

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Manifold Shootout for the Carbureted LS Crowd
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Six manifolds with an old-school carb and a new-school 6.0 LS are tested. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220916

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Exhaust Cutouts
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Proponents have always claimed exhaust cutouts make a car faster; seeing how they stack up against a full exhaust and a header extension behind a heavy-breathing 598-cubic-inch Big Block Chevy. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20220923

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Every Trick in the Book
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The crew shows how to unlock the power lurking in an existing engine combination without buying, changing or upgrading a single component; they use tricks they've learned over the years to tune every HP out of the 410 Windsor from David's Disgustang. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230120

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Low Buck SBC Head Shootout
motortrendfasttv.us.description: No matter how many LS swaps are out there, the old-school SBC is still an absolute force in the marketplace; the guys bolt three of the lowest-buck cylinder heads out there to their Ultimate Average 383 and make pulls for power. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230120

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Pick-a-Carb Shootout
motortrendfasttv.us.description: This test is all about choosing the features you want and need on a carburetor, and how those features affect horsepower and tunability. Do mechanical secondaries really make any more power than vacuum-power ones? Does a choke horn restrict inlet airflow? (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230127

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Single Pattern vs. Split Pattern Cams
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys have tested single V-split pattern cams before and concluded that a split pattern can increase top-end power without necessarily affecting bottom-end torque; their findings have been challenged, and they're here for the science. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230127

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Oil Pumps for Power?!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys test three LS oil pumps in different volume and oil pressure configurations to see if too much pressure reduces horsepower. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230203

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Quest for F-Rod Greatness
motortrendfasttv.us.description: What do you do when your 800-horsepower 572 just won't get you consistent eight-second passes in your '31 Model A? Well, if you're David Freiburger, you strap it to the Westech dyno to tune, poke and swap at until you're at a comfortable 950+ horsepower. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230203

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Six Pack Shootout!!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The six-pack was designed to supply part-throttle economy to the center while the outside carbs kick in for power; the guys test three six-pack designs to find out which is gimmick, which is greatness and which makes the most power on a street 440. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230210

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - The Magic of the Flex Fuel Sensor
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The ability to run a blend of gas and E85 is a game changer; credit the flex fuel sensor, which samples fuel composition and adjusts fuel flow, making more power as more E85 is mixed in. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230210

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - The Leaker Episode
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Do boost leaks really even matter? Can vacuum leaks make more power? You read those questions right. Come be surprised right along with us as we find power in unexpected places, and lose less than we'd expect in others. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230217

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Wet vs. Dry Nitrous
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Discovering how a wet system stacks up against a dry system in an EFI manifold. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230224

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Carb v. EFI: The Multipoint Edition

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Engine Masters - Blown vs. NA -- Two Ways to 1,000 hp

outlaw.us.title: Cimarron
outlaw.us.description: After Sabra (Maria Schell) marries cowboy Yancey Cravat (Glenn Ford) against her parents' wishes, the newlyweds travel to Oklahoma to participate in a land rush for territory taken from the Indians. Settling down in their new community, Yancey becomes locally prominent as the editor of the town newspaper. When he turns down an offer to run for governor because his oil-money backers would demand more property from the Indians, Sabra's disapproval drives Yancey to leave. (Western) - 1960

outlaw.us.title: Ride the High Country
outlaw.us.description: Reduced to transporting gold from a distant mine to a small-town bank, retired lawman Steve Judd (Joel McCrea) recruits friend Gil Westrum (Randolph Scott), who has been performing in a traveling carnival. Unknown to Steve, the restless Gil and a young drifter intend to steal the next gold transport. On the way, the men help Elsa Knudsen (Mariette Hartley) to break free from her zealot father and join her fiancé at the mine, not realizing the consequences that await them all. (Western) - 1962

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - The Trail Gang

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - The Savage
outlaw.us.description: Attacked by Shoshones while crossing a burial ground, Adam discovers that the Indian woman tending him is white. (Drama, Western) - 1960-12-03

outlaw.us.title: How the West Was Won - The Hearing
outlaw.us.description: As Luke's hearing commences, Frank Grayson presents evidence that hurts his case; Doreen frames Josh for assault. (Western, History, Adventure, Drama) - 1978-05-14

outlaw.us.title: The Godchild
outlaw.us.description: Three escaped Civil War prisoners (Jack Palance, Jack Warden, Keith Carradine) stop to help a dying woman deliver a baby in the desert. (Western) - 1974

outlaw.us.title: Pharaoh's Army
outlaw.us.description: Abston (Chris Cooper), a Union Army captain, leads his Civil War regiment to a Kentucky farm run by Sarah Anders (Patricia Clarkson), whose husband is off fighting for the Confederates. Although cordial respect develops between Abston and Sarah, war-related incidents cause mounting difficulties and shifting loyalties. Sarah's young son draws the local preacher (Kris Kristofferson) into the situation, and, after a galvanizing sermon, a bloody confrontation is at hand. (War, Drama) - 1995

outlaw.us.title: Shoot-Out at Medicine Bend
outlaw.us.description: Just discharged from service, Capt. Devlin (Randolph Scott) and his cavalry pals Maitland (James Garner) and Clegg (Gordon Jones) travel to Devlin's brother's home, but arrive to see the place overrun by American Indians. Devlin's sibling is killed because of his shoddy ammo, so the captain and his friends decide to hunt down the man who sold the bum bullets. They ride into town and find that the culprit is Clark (James Craig), a rich businessman who has the law in his pocket. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: Gold of the Seven Saints
outlaw.us.description: After discovering a fortune in gold nuggets, Shaun Garrett (Roger Moore) and his partner, Jim Rainbolt (Clint Walker), make their way toward the town of Seven Saints to redeem it for cash. Word of their find reaches bandit McCracken (Gene Evans), who comes after them. The men hide their treasure and fend off McCracken with the help of Doc Gates (Chill Wills), before escaping to recover at the ranch of Rainbolt's friend, Amos Gondora (Robert Middleton), waiting until they can retrieve the gold. (Western) - 1961

outlaw.us.title: Devil's Canyon
outlaw.us.description: Abby (Virginia Mayo) runs with a brutal group of robbers in the Arizona Territory, but when she learns that members of her gang are targeting Billy (Dale Robertson), an old acquaintance, she tips him off. Billy kills the would-be assailants and is sent to prison, where he is incarcerated with Jessie (Stephen McNally), who is both the brother of the men Billy killed and Abby's lover. When Abby also gets locked up, her allegiance to the two rivals makes for an explosive situation. (Western) - 1953

outtvproud.us.title: Georgia Rule
outtvproud.us.description: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside. (Drama) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Fierce People
outtvproud.us.description: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

outtvproud.us.title: 3 Generations

outtvproud.us.title: Laggies
outtvproud.us.description: When 28-year-old Megan attends her 10-year high-school reunion, she realizes that very little in her life has changed. An unexpected marriage proposal from her boyfriend sparks panic in Megan, causing her to wander off into the night. She meets 16-year-old Annika and proceeds to get drunk. Deciding she needs a break from her unfulfilling life, she tells her boyfriend she's going to a seminar but hangs with Annika. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2014

outtvproud.us.title: The Disaster Artist

outtvproud.us.title: Sometimes They Come Back... Again

Now he must go home for the funeral of his mother, who died under strange circumstances. While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed. (Horror) - 1996

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 New Generation Style Ashley and Colin can't wait to see how Nicole and Caffrey transform Ashley's grandmother's dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home; and Caffrey gets Nicole on board with giving his good friend Marlene a much-needed refresh of her home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Speakeasy to Me Nicole and Caffery bring all the moody design vibes to their first speakeasy lounge for game enthusiasts Krysti and Dana; while real estate agent Natalie's compact condo listing needs staging help to spark it into a luxe and warm downtown home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Every Woman's Dream Home Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that's for the girls - feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they're trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 An Elevated Lower Level Nicole and Caffrey design a basement getaway for Sharon, Jason and their growing tweens, creating a space where they'll actually want to hang out. They'll also help real estate pro Haaris get his bungalow listing polished up in a competitive market.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Invest In Your Kitchen Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Suite Retreat Nicole and Caffrey design an executive rental suite to help supplement Vashti's path to retirement, while real estate agent Kelsey pursues Nicole and Caffrey's much-needed staging expertise to help sell her clients' colorful and chaotic townhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 100 Years Newer After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffrey to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Builder Basic to Modern Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffrey to bring a 'styled' look to their very empty new home, and Andrea's trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 A Modern Home and Rental Chrissy's multipurpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Elevated Oasis With renters in the basement, Sarah and Shawn have nowhere to go but up to find some tranquility. Nicole and Caffrey take on their dated bedroom and ensuite to create an elevated oasis.

tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds

Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - The Interwar Period

(Educational, History) - 2003-06-09

truehistory.us.title: The United States and the Middle East: 1914 to 9/11 - U.S. & the Middle East During World War II

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish

truehistory.us.title: Creation Stories of the Ancient World - The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion

(World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
truehistory.us.description: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Arab Invasion of North Africa - 639

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in Middle Eastern History - Umayyad Caliphate in Damascus - 661
truehistory.us.description: The establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate's capital in Damascus is a key event in early Muslim history; the Umayyads' achievements; locating the empire's capital away from the Arabian Peninsula; the shift from an Islamic empire to imperial power. (World history) - 2016-02-05

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: An Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed after pulling over a van for a traffic violation. Officers apprehend the shooter, after a car chase and shootout. ATF is alerted when officers find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Further testing of the weapons reveals one was used in a murder several months earlier. ATF traces some of the firearms to purchases made by another man from and arms dealer. They also match silencer marks from the weapons to a third man previously arrested for stealing a flatbed truck.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A Washington DC professor is shot and killed as she tries to get into her car. The killer leaves the body in the parking lot and drives away in her vehicle. A week later, a man robs a bank, and security cameras capture the same vehicle as the getaway car. The FBI believes they are dealing with the same man. Days later, the same vehicle is involved in a shootout with police, but eventually would elude them. Eventually, the vehicle is found, the interior covered with red dye from the stolen bank packs.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Four inmates from a Delaware Correctional Center turn up missing in the middle of the night. A few hours later, a stolen vehicle is recovered; inside, one of the inmate's fingerprints is found, as well as the address book of one of the other fugitives. A multi-state manhunt ensues with the help of the FBI. A nearby robbery report is the agent's first tip, followed by a murder in the same neighborhood.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the Spring of 1997, a killer preying on senior citizens terrorizes the River Parish area of Southern Louisiana. By May, local police and the New Orleans FBI are exploring a connection between the April 9 murder of a 71-year old widow and the May 9 murder of a retired couple. A month later, authorities forward information on the crimes to the FBI's Behavioral Science Unit in Quantico, VA, hoping a profile will help them narrow the field of possible suspects.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On December 21, 1998, two gunmen kidnap three janitors on their way to clean the Bank of America ATM repository in Las Vegas. The gunmen force the janitors to let them in the ATM repository and hold them hostage until the armored car guards arrive to make their nightly collection. When the guards enter the bank, the gunmen surprise them and shoot one guard in the chest before escaping with $1,088,000, the largest bank robbery take in Las Vegas history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Henderson, NV, a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambush armored guards as they exit their truck on March 3, 2000. The robbers kill both guards and seize $5,000. As the killers run to their getaway car, a police officer arrives and opens fire, striking one escaping assailant in the leg. After loosing the killers in a chase, police collect blood left by the injured robber and bullet casings from the firefight.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 12, 1997, two men use a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, NJ home. The homeowner shoots at the intruders, hitting one in the hand before they escape. Camden Police respond and track the suspects to a nearby park. One of the men shoots at the officer before police arrest his accomplice. The man gives up the identity of the shooter. Twice, police stake out homes where they believe the shooter is hiding, but he eludes them.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When violent criminals strike, the FBI strikes back, employing every available resource, and creating new ones when necessary. From forensic science to criminal profiling, specialized intelligence to global fugitive tracking, the agents of the FBI battle the bad guys with a most powerful arsenal: the crime-fighter's toolbox. This special episode of The FBI Files celebrates the groundbreaking science, investigative technique, and gut-level instinct that has made the FBI the world's premier law enforcement agency.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1970's, Otpor, a violent arm of the Croatian National Resistance commits terroristic acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the U.S. With the help of an informant, the FBI is able to apprehend, arrest and convict members of the group for crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1994, a rash of home invasion robberies take place in the metropolitan Detroit area. The thieves turn out to be part of a local gang dubbed the Home Invaders. Their crimes extend to insurance fraud, theft, and illegal lottery schemes. The Violent Crimes Task Force (VCTF) opens an investigation, and with the cooperation of a gang member who was apprehended at the scene of a crime, they are able to obtain the names, addresses, and telephone numbers of 16 gang members.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: This is the story of the FBI's first capture of an international Lebanese terrorist. In June 1985, the terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian flight #405 shortly before take off in Beirut, Lebanon. On board were American citizens, a professor and his teen son. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force specifically charged with bringing the terrorist to justice in 1989.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors. All agents had to go on was a series of chilling phone calls, a mysterious voice, and the threat of more violence. FBI field offices from New York to Miami coordinated their efforts, determined to catch the vicious killers.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 70s and early 80s, a terrorist group known as the FALN is suspected of setting off bombs in major U.S. cities. Their goal - to bring attention to the Puerto Rican independence movement. As the bombings escalate, innocent lives are lost. FBI agents and police are is in a deadly race to stop this murderous group with a dangerous cause.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power leads to a full-scale mob war. The local Mafia crime family splits in two as the young and the old fight to the death. The FBI is caught in the middle as they infiltrate the syndicate through informants and high-tech surveillance. Agents must find a way to bring down the organization before their civil war leads to innocent causalities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the late 1980s, the FBI matches wits with a cunning bank robber -- a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history. The robber's planning is meticulous. He executes his crimes with military precision. It will take the combined skills of local police and dozens of agents to catch a criminal mastermind they call, "The Shootist."

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Puerto Rico, violent militants are intent on turning the US Commonwealth into a communist dictatorship. They murder a policeman, turns their guns on a busload of unarmed Navy workers, and even launch an attack on the FBI. These ruthless killers have vowed to fight to the death. The FBI must use every tactic at their disposal to track down the terrorists and bring them to justice.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the 1980s, the drug trade ravages Chicago's inner city neighborhoods and violent crime threatens to destroy entire communities. As drug profits grow, gangs rule the streets. One of the most dangerous is the El Rukns. FBI Agents team up with state and local police to bring them down, but in the process, uncover a bizarre and frightening terrorist plot.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Washington D.C, a car bomb takes the life of a former ambassador and his secretary. The FBI is on the case and begins sifting through layers of a wide-ranging conspiracy. The scope of the investigation broadens when it becomes apparent that a foreign government, ruled by a ruthless dictator, ordered the attack. Agents and prosecutors must engage in a political tug-of-war to uncover the identities of the assassins.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, extortionists plant a thousand pound bomb in a Nevada casino and demand millions of dollars, or they will detonate the device. The bomb is the largest explosive device the FBI has ever seen. Detonation would be a disaster. Agents and bomb experts must disarm the deadly device, and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports. One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel. The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

673500.title: The Wackiest Ship in the Army
673500.description: During WW II, Lt. Rip Crandall and his inexperienced and motley crew get assigned to deliver an Australian observer to a Japanese-held island.

673500.title: You Were Never Lovelier
673500.description: Bob Davis (Fred Astaire), an American dancer in Buenos Aires, Argentina, finds himself desperate for work after losing all his money. He takes a gig at a wedding, hoping to impress the bride's father, Eduardo Acuña (Adolphe Menjou), a local club owner who has decreed that his daughters must marry in order of age. Eduardo eventually agrees to allow Bob to perform at his club, but only under the condition that he play suitor to his second-oldest daughter, the beautiful Maria (Rita Hayworth).

673500.title: A Raisin in the Sun
673500.description: Sidney Poitier stars in this iconic version of the famous play about a cash poor family who start to fray when they inherit a life insurance payout.

673500.title: Hot Blood
673500.description: A gypsy woman who lives by decamping with marriage settlements from wealthy men meets her match in the handsome younger brother of a gypsy king.

673500.title: The Heroes of Telemark
673500.description: In German-occupied Norway in 1942, a resistance group attempts to sabotage the Nazi's production of essential atomic bomb components.

673500.title: Forbidden
673500.description: In this fast-paced potboiler, a district attorney begins having an affair with a staid librarian, who ultimately gets pregnant with their child.

673500.title: Tell It to the Judge
673500.description: Marsha Meredith (Rosalind Russell) has just been offered a position as a federal judge. Much to her dismay, her nomination is challenged on the grounds that her divorce renders her unsuitable for the courtroom. Desperate to win the position, Marsha arranges a fake marriage to Alexander (Gig Young), even though she still has feelings for Peter (Robert Cummings), her ex-husband. Marsha and Alexander -- and Marsha and Peter -- soon find themselves in a series of compromising situations.

673500.title: Gidget Grows Up
673500.description: Heartbroken after her boyfriend joins the Air Force without a word, Gidget seeks peace by becoming a tour guide at the United Nations in New York.

673500.title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
673500.description: War widow Janet Ames (Rosalind Russell) is struck by a car, and later her doctors suspect she may have been attempting suicide. A note in her pocket lists five men whom her husband died saving in battle, and they are contacted to help Janet's recovery. The first man on the list, jaded reporter Smitty Cobb (Melvyn Douglas), is offended when Janet says she hopes to prove her husband died in vain to save five worthless men, and offers to "introduce" Janet to each of the men through hypnotism.

673500.title: Pal Joey
673500.description: Charming musical featuring the love triangle between a lovable but mischievous man and the two women who could change his life, for love or money.

673500.title: Craig's Wife
673500.description: A pushy pessimist with an eye for the finer things in life, Harriet (Rosalind Russell) has married Walter Craig (John Boles) because he is able to provide the kind of posh lifestyle she is certain she deserves. She feels not the slightest bit of guilt about her lack of affection for her husband, and aside from John himself, everyone around her seems to realize this. But when her husband gets a scare involving the police, Harriet's way of life is threatened.

673498.title: End of the Trail
673498.description: An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

673498.title: Men Without Law
673498.description: Returning from the war, Buck gets caught by Murdock, who takes his letter of introduction to the Del Reys. Posing as Buck, Murdock takes Del Ray's jewels and his daughter Jaunita. To rescue Juanita, Buck poses as Murdock.

673498.title: Renegades
673498.description: Hannah Brockway (Evelyn Keyes) has a perfect fiancé in Dr. Sam Martin (Willard Parker). Sam, who is respected by Hannah's family, is a noble man who cares for her and can make a good living in their frontier town. Yet Hannah craves adventure and finds it when she meets dashing Ben Dembrow (Larry Parks), the youngest of a notorious crime family. Together Ben and Hannah set off to forge a new life, but prejudice and strangling family ties soon bring trouble to these newlyweds.

673498.title: The Great Sioux Massacre
673498.description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

673498.title: Masterson of Kansas
673498.description: In the 1870s, Marshal Wyatt Earp (Bruce Cowling) calls upon Dodge City, Kan., Sheriff Bat Masterson (George Montgomery) to track down rancher Merrick (John Maxwell), who is accused of murder. But, thanks to some proof held by local Native American Chief Yellow Hawk (Jay Silverheels), Masterson realizes Merrick might be the victim of a frame-up. So, with the help of Earp and gunfighter Doc Holliday (James Griffith), Masterson sets out to find those who are really behind the killing.

673498.title: Massacre Canyon
673498.description: A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.

673498.title: Daring Danger
673498.description: A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.

673498.title: The Quick Gun
673498.description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

673498.title: Gunmen From Laredo
673498.description: A framed Texas rancher (Robert Knapp) escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).

673498.title: Mackenna's Gold
673498.description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

673498.title: Blazing Across the Pecos
673498.description: The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.

673498.title: The Black Dakotas
673498.description: A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.

673498.title: Fury at Gunsight Pass
673498.description: One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.

692114.title: Sorry to Bother You
692114.description: In a modern-day alternate version of Oakland, Chase Green, a telemarketer, gets a magical power that makes him a wealthy salesman.

692114.title: Malibooty
692114.description: Three friends in need of an escape from reality, take a hilarious road trip to Malibu for a wild beach party.

692114.title: Fatal Beauty
692114.description: A tough narcotics cop probes a deadly drug called Fatal Beauty, uncovering a trail that leads to a mysterious company and a hidden criminal network.

692114.title: Next Day Air
692114.description: Laughs, larceny, and mayhem are all in the delivery when a cache of cocaine is mistakenly sent by a down-on-his-luck driver to a team of inept crooks.

692114.title: A Haunted House
692114.description: In this hilarious and demonically good spoof on the found-footage genre, a couple finds that their new house is haunted by a supernatural presence.

692114.title: A Haunted House 2
692114.description: Having exorcized the demons of his ex, Malcolm starts fresh with his new girlfriend—only to find his home once again plagued by paranormal events.

692114.title: Sprung
692114.description: Two pairs of best friends meet, fall in love, and encounter very different sets of expectations about what their romantic futures hold.

692114.title: Hart of the City
692114.description: Kevin Hart goes to Jackson, M.S., to showcase comedy from Marvin Hunter, Rita Brent, and more.

692114.title: Lyft Comics

692114.title: Real Husbands of Hollywood
692114.description: Kevin flirts with a "cougar" who surprisingly returns his attention.

692114.title: Real Husbands of Hollywood

692114.description: Arsenio Hall shows up to poker night with Craig Robinson—who had a role in sabotaging Kevin’s pilot.

692114.title: Kevin Hart: Lyft Legend
692114.description: Donald scams riders with fake cookies, spins voodoo tales, and Jaleel White joins the chaos.

692114.title: Kevin Hart Presents Lil' Rel: RELevent
692114.description: Hart hosts the high-energy comic who riffs on his upbringing, raising kids, and public transportation, proving he can be hilarious and relevant.

692114.title: Wedding Daze

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Police patrolling the night streets hear gunshots and head to the scene. They find a nude middle-aged man in parking lot lying face down in a puddle of blood.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: While in the process of adopting a five-week-old baby, a mother takes him to work with her. While there, the baby inexplicably obtains a skull fracture while unsupervised.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition. Dr. G finds bullets in the bodies and determines that they were all shot before being set on fire.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: An employee is found dead in a restaurant kitchen. Clues found near the body include an empty cash register, a knife and a trail of blood splotches leading to a vandalized car in the parking lot.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A healthy 53-year-old woman is found dead in bed. After performing an autopsy and taking blood and tissue samples, Dr. G cannot find the cause of death.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn't what it seems.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple haven't seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Melissa Riobe's life is ruled by her addiction to drugs. Now, the 42-year-old woman has learned how to buy powerful prescription drugs online without a doctor's note.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Recent college grad Robert Terrible is out drinking at a club with friends celebrating. At 3am, he realizes he better call it a night and heads to the nearby garage where he parked his car.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: It's an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a short-cut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can't believe his eyes.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: It is 3am and Deputy Torres is cruising a Texas highway when he suddenly spots a crushed pick-up truck along the side of the road. Trapped inside is the lifeless body of 24-year-old Luis Reyes.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Carol Moleskie agrees to go on a hunting excursion with her husband, Bob. A few hours after they enter the woods, they emerge again, Bob frantically waving down traffic as he carries his bloody wife.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: It's a late night and a Vietnam veteran with a history of mental illness is drunk and stumbling through an apartment complex. When the police arrive, he pulls a gun and shoots himself in the head.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: When the husband, Tao Chen, is shot to death by his wife Jun, she claims she pulled the trigger in self-defense when a drunken Tao came after her with a gun.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: After a brief illness, 34-year old Claire Jackson dies suddenly in the hospital from massive liver failure and winds up in Dr. G's morgue.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A quadriplegic woman loved by her community is found dead in an Orlando park 150ft from her motorized wheelchair. Children find her lifeless body face down in the sand.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Jerra Kirby, who's visiting family in Orlando, has suddenly passed out at a theme park wave pool and the paramedics are trying desperately to revive her.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Chris Schaffer has not been seen or heard from in five days. Finally, his friends find him dead and decomposed in the driver's seat of his van.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Ricky Hawthorne, a middle-aged man with a history of AIDS, arrives at his local hospital complaining of chest pains. Doctors perform extensive tests on him but find nothing wrong and release him.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Police are driving down the street when a man suddenly jumps in front of their car. They screech to a halt and avoid hitting him, but the man is highly agitated.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: Teenagers stumble across a horrifying car fire on the side of a desolate stretch of roadway. When the police arrive, they pull severely burned human remains from the driver's seat.

724209.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
724209.description: A retired military officer is found dead in his own backyard during a freak ice storm in San Antonio, Texas.

692051.title: Nightbreed
692051.description: Aaron Boone (Craig Sheffer) is haunted by terrifying nightmares of a city of monsters. He goes to see a psychiatrist, Dr. Decker (David Cronenberg), for help. But what Boone doesn't know is that Decker is really a serial killer. Decker frames Boone to take the fall for his murders, and Boone is killed by the police. But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

But Boone is brought back to life by the monsters of his dreams, the Nightbreed, who in turn join Boone in his quest to stop Decker from killing again.

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Rock Pools

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Grampy Rabbit in Space

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - George's Birthday

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Emily Elephant

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Painting

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Stone Age Granny

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - The Marble Run

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Caravan Friends

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Granny Sheep's Art Van

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hippies

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Looking for Things

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Hot Dry Day

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Nursery Rhymes

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Dr Michael Mosley shows Adam and Brihony Dawson what to cook for a good night's sleep and gives some tips on how to get a solid 8 hours a night.

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Noel gives Maine Coon cat Lexie a bilateral total hip replacement, while one-year-old bouncy Border terrier Charlie is in pain and is struggling to walk, and dwarf rabbit Locky has broken his leg.

sbsbrisbane.au.description: Ken Jennings hosts Jeopardy! Where the answers are revealed, and the contestants must guess the appropriate questions.

sbsbrisbane.au.description: In this round, the specialty subjects are The Reign of Hatshepsut, Melbourne cup: 1980-2000, Monty Python's Flying Circus, and Rent (Original Broadway Production).

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Who Do You Think You Are?

sbsbrisbane.au.title: 2.6 Seconds: Death in the Outback
sbsbrisbane.au.description: A landmark documentary series examining the events and far-reaching repercussions of the two fatal shots fired in 2.6 seconds that ended the life of 19-year-old Kumanjayi Walker.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Point
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In The Point, JP Janke meets Warlpiri Elder Ned Hargraves to explore culture, Country and the lasting impact of Kumanjayi Walker's death on policing, justice and trust in Yuendumu.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News Late
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Going Places with Ernie Dingo

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Cold Summer
sbsbrisbane.au.description: The discovery of a victim of the criminal war that has broken out in Bari shakes the spirits of Fenoglio and his colleagues and starts a desperate manhunt.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Snow
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Alma has disappeared without a trace. The search operation is complicated by the mountain weather. Lucia is convinced her daughter is alive, even though the chances are getting slimmer.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Snow
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Two nights have passed since Alma's disappearance. The breathless search is futile and now there is avalanche danger. Everyone doubts Alma's survival and the rescue mission is called off.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E3 Midtlylland, Denmark Tareq pays a visit to the western part of Denmark, where he explores the region called Midtjylland.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Kriol Kitchen

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: My Market Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E31 Episode 31 Laura proves her title as the Pasta Queen with her Timballo Pasta. Veggie Farmer Catherine Velisha brings a Roasted Broccoli with Butter Bean Puree dish that is chockfull of vegetables.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie At Home
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E1 Tomatoes Jamie Oliver cooks tomato salad, fusilli with salsa rossa cruda, oven-baked sausage ragu, pale pink tomato and vodka consomme top and tails.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E60 Episode 60 Special guest Luke Hines joins Everyday Gourmet today to whip up his delicious Spicy Sweet Potato Rosti with Indian Avocado Smash.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices
